Refactoring proposals (not applied)

  • Split `src/multiplayer.cc` into smaller translation units (LAN lobby, Internet rooms, transports, lockstep, resync, placement, config).
  • Introduce a `Transport` interface so session logic uses one send/recv/poll API regardless of direct vs relays.
  • Move protocol framing/serialization into a single `.cc/.hh` module (and consider sharing codec logic with the Python lobby to prevent drift).
  • Make start/restart/abort/next-level transitions an explicit state machine with documented invariants.
  • Extract `MultiplayerMenu` into model vs view/layout and move layout constants/calculations into helpers to reduce redraw/layout regressions.
  • Centralize multiplayer config parsing/validation (host, toggles, ports, env overrides) into one struct shared between UI and runtime.
  • Add an in-process integration test harness with a fake transport to test join/start/restart/resync/peer-leave deterministically.
  • Document the checksum surface in `WorldChecksum` (what is hashed and why) to reduce future non-determinism regressions.

1# Multiplayer (User Guide + Architecture)
2
3This document covers the full multiplayer feature set. It is split into:
4
5- **User Guide**: how to use LAN/Internet multiplayer.
6- **Architecture**: how it works internally and how we avoid desync.
7
8It is not a changelog.
9
10## User Guide
11
12### Opening multiplayer
13
14From the main menu, choose **Network Game** to open the multiplayer lobby.
15
16### Internet server configuration (once)
17
18Open **Options -> Multiplayer** and set:
19
20- **Lobby/Relay Server**: hostname or IP of the shared server (default: `CHANGEME`)
21- Ports:
22 - Lobby (UDP, default 12347)
23 - UDP relay (UDP, default 12348)
24 - TCP relay (TCP, default 12349)
25- Connection strategies (toggles):
26 - Direct connect
27 - UDP relay
28 - TCP relay
29
30If multiple strategies are enabled, clients try them in this order:
31
32`Direct` -> `UDP relay` -> `TCP relay` (skipping disabled strategies).
33
34### LAN mode (local network)
35
36LAN mode uses UDP broadcast discovery.
37
381) Start Enigma on two (or more) machines in the same LAN (or multiple instances locally).
392) Open **Network Game** on all machines.
403) The other players should appear in the lobby.
414) Pick a **Level Pack**.
425) Use **Maps for N** to filter maps by intended player count.
436) The host starts a game by clicking a level icon.
44
45### Internet mode (room code)
46
47Internet mode uses a lobby server for room membership and "start" coordination, then
48uses direct connect or relays for the actual game session.
49
501) Ensure the server host + ports are configured (Options -> Multiplayer).
512) Switch the lobby to **Internet mode**.
523) Host enters a **Room code** and clicks **Create Room**.
534) Other players enter the same room code and click **Join Room**.
545) Once players joined, only the host selects a level (clients show "Waiting for host...").
556) Host starts a game by clicking a level icon.
56
57If UDP is blocked (guest WiFi, corporate networks, VPNs), enable **TCP relay** as fallback.
58
59### Debugging toggles
60
61Set environment variables before launching Enigma:
62
63- `ENIGMA_MP_DEBUG=1` enables verbose multiplayer logs.
64- `ENIGMA_MP_FORCE_RELAY=1` forces relay use (skips direct connect), useful for testing.
65
66## Architecture
67
68### High-level model: deterministic lockstep
69
70Multiplayer is deterministic lockstep:
71
72- Each instance runs the full simulation locally.
73- Inputs are exchanged per fixed tick.
74- The host distributes inputs but does not stream full authoritative state.
75- Periodic sync snapshots detect drift and can correct some divergence.
76
77This keeps latency low while maintaining a consistent world state.
78
79### Lobby discovery and start
80
81LAN discovery:
82
83- Each peer periodically broadcasts `LobbyAnnounce` over UDP broadcast.
84- The host starts by broadcasting `LobbyStart`.
85
86Internet discovery (room codes):
87
88- Server: `tools/internet_lobby_server.py` (UDP, default 12347)
89- Room membership uses Create/Join/Leave/Poll requests.
90- Rooms are removed when the last member has timed out.
91
92`LobbyStart` carries session metadata:
93
94- `session_id`
95- `seed` (for deterministic RNG)
96- `expected_players`
97- `host_port`
98- `host_id`
99- map filter settings (minimum intended player count)
100
101### Session transport options
102
103All game-session payloads use a single message protocol (`src/multiplayer_protocol.hh`).
104How those payloads are transported depends on connectivity:
105
1061) **Direct**: client connects to host via ENet (`host_ip:host_port`).
1072) **UDP relay**: client connects to relay via ENet; relay forwards ENet packets between client and host.
1083) **TCP relay**: client connects to relay via raw TCP; relay forwards framed payloads between client and host.
109
110#### ENet versioning (vendored vs system)
111
112Enigma historically shipped a vendored ENet (`lib-src/enet`, libenet 1.0). Most modern distro builds
113(Ubuntu/Debian, Homebrew) use system ENet (ENet 1.3.x).
114
115ENet API signatures differ between these versions (e.g. `enet_host_create`, `enet_host_connect`,
116`enet_socket_create`), so multiplayer uses `src/enet_ver.hh` and small shims to compile against both.
117
118Important: the **UDP relay uses ENet itself**, so the relay must be built against an ENet version
119compatible with the clients. In practice, that means using ENet 1.3.x for deployed Internet relays.
120
121### Keeping simulations in sync
122
123#### Input lockstep and delay
124
125- Inputs are queued per tick for all players.
126- `input::CanAdvanceTick()` enforces that a tick only advances once all inputs are present.
127- A fixed input delay (`kInputDelay`) sends inputs slightly ahead to absorb jitter.
128
129#### Input epoch
130
131Each start/restart increments an `input_epoch`:
132
133- `NET_START`, `NET_INPUT`, `NET_SYNC` carry the epoch.
134- Packets from a previous epoch are ignored.
135
136This prevents late packets from a prior level/restart from corrupting the new simulation.
137
138#### Drift detection: RNG + checksums
139
140Periodic `NET_SYNC` snapshots include:
141
142- tick
143- RNG state
144- checksums over relevant world/actor state
145
146Clients compare these snapshots to local state:
147
148- If only RNG diverged, RNG can be corrected without restarting.
149- If world/actor checksums diverge, a resync is attempted.
150
151#### Resync ("soft resync")
152
153When divergence is detected:
154
155- Client requests a resync from the host.
156- Host responds with a compact actor-state snapshot (position/velocity + ids).
157- Client applies it and continues.
158
159If resync fails repeatedly, the session reports a desync.
160
161### Extra players on low-player maps (non-optimized mode)
162
163If more players join than the map was authored for:
164
165- The first N players use authored start positions.
166- Additional players are auto-placed by the host:
167 - choose the closest safe, free floor tile with clear sight to the base player start
168 - fall back to a random free tile if needed
169
170The host broadcasts placements so all instances spawn identically.
171
172### Restarts / next level
173
174Restarts are host-authoritative:
175
176- Host sends `NET_RESTART`.
177- Clients restart via network-specific entry points (avoids host-only guards).
178
179This ensures all instances restart in lockstep.
180
181## Deployment
182
183### Docker (single container)
184
185For Internet play, both services can be run in one container:
186
187- `tools/internet_lobby_server.py` (UDP lobby)
188- `tools/relay_server.cc` (UDP ENet relay)
189- `tools/tcp_relay_server.cc` (TCP relay fallback)
190
191The Docker image builds the UDP relay against distro ENet (`libenet-dev`) to match typical client
192builds that use system ENet.
193
194```sh
195docker build -t enigma-mp .
196docker run --rm \
197 -p 12347:12347/udp \
198 -p 12348:12348/udp \
199 -p 12349:12349/tcp \
200 enigma-mp
201```
202
203### Manual (no Docker)
204
205On Ubuntu/Debian you typically want:
206
207- `python3` for the lobby server
208- `libenet-dev` for the UDP relay
209
210Then run:
211
212- `python3 tools/internet_lobby_server.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 12347`
213- `./enigma-relay --host 0.0.0.0 --port 12348`
214- `./enigma-tcp-relay --host 0.0.0.0 --port 12349`
215
216## Regression tests (ad-hoc)
217
218The repository includes small, framework-free regression tests:
219
220```sh
221g++ -std=c++14 -D_THREAD_SAFE \
222 -Isrc -Ilib-src/enigma-core -Ilib-src -I/opt/homebrew/include -I/opt/homebrew/include/SDL2 \
223 tests/test_multiplayer_protocol.cc lib-src/enigma-core/libecl.a \
224 -o /tmp/test_multiplayer_protocol && /tmp/test_multiplayer_protocol
225
226g++ -std=c++14 -D_THREAD_SAFE \
227 -Isrc -Ilib-src/enigma-core -Ilib-src -I/opt/homebrew/include -I/opt/homebrew/include/SDL2 \
228 tests/test_input.cc src/input.cc lib-src/enigma-core/libecl.a \
229 -o /tmp/test_input && /tmp/test_input
230```
231

M src/client.cc

Where it is used: SDL event handling and HUD timing (client-side).
Key symbols touched: server::Msg_MouseForce options::GetDouble input::SubmitMouseForce player::CurrentPlayer multiplayer::IsActive server::Msg_ActivateItem input::SubmitActivateItem input::SubmitRotateInventory player::RotateInventory player::SetCurrentPlayer
What changed:
  • Routes mouse/inventory actions into the tick-based input queue (`input::Submit*`) rather than immediate server mutation.
  • Avoids auto-pausing on focus loss in multiplayer (pausing one peer stalls lockstep).
  • Uses server time for HUD time display in multiplayer so peers show the same clock.
  • Sets `CurrentPlayer` to the local network player index after loading a multiplayer level.

A src/gui/MultiplayerMenu.cc

Where it is used: New multiplayer lobby UI (LAN and Internet).
Key symbols touched: lev::VolatileIndex Index::registerIndex Index::getGroupNames Index::getGroup options::GetInt options::GetString MultiplayerMenu::MultiplayerMenu multiplayer::LobbyStart Index::getCurrentIndex Index::setCurrentIndex
What changed:
  • Shows LAN lobby peers (broadcast) or Internet room members and indicates which transport is in use.
  • Host selects pack/map; clicking a map icon starts when enough players are present.
  • Orders levels deterministically (difficulty then name) and provides player-count filtering (“Maps for N / 1-N / 2-N / ...”).
  • Synchronizes selection state (pack, filter, chosen map) across peers so clients do not need manual matching.
  • Implements Create/Join/Leave flow for Internet rooms and locks UI fields while in-room.

38 lev::VolatileIndex *ensure_lobby_index() {
39 if (s_lobby_index != nullptr)
40 return s_lobby_index;
41 std::vector<std::string> empty;
42 s_lobby_index = new lev::VolatileIndex("Multiplayer Lobby",
43 "Network Levels", "Multiplayer", empty, INDEX_DEFAULT_PACK_LOCATION);
44 lev::Index::registerIndex(s_lobby_index);
45 return s_lobby_index;
46 }

48 lev::Index *find_pack_for_level_id(const std::string &level_id, lev::Index *lobby_index) {
49 std::vector<std::string> groups = lev::Index::getGroupNames();
50 for (const auto &group : groups) {
51 std::vector<lev::Index *> *indices = lev::Index::getGroup(group);
52 if (!indices)
53 continue;
54 for (auto *index : *indices) {
55 if (!index || index == lobby_index)
56 continue;
57 if (index->hasNormLevelPath(level_id))
58 return index;
59 }
60 }
61 return nullptr;
62 }

64 struct InternetServers {
65 std::string lobby;
66 std::string udp_relay;
67 std::string tcp_relay;
68 };
69
70 static Uint16 clamp_port(int value, Uint16 fallback) {
71 if (value > 0 && value <= 65535)
72 return static_cast<Uint16>(value);
73 return fallback;
74 }
75
76 InternetServers resolve_internet_servers(const std::string &server) {
77 InternetServers out;
78 if (server == "CHANGEME")
79 return out;
80 std::string host = server;
81 // Backwards-compat: if the saved config still contains host:port, strip the port.
82 std::string::size_type pos = host.rfind(':');
83 if (pos != std::string::npos)
84 host = host.substr(0, pos);
85
86 if (host == "localhost" || host == "::1")
87 host = "127.0.0.1";
88 if (host.empty())
89 return out;
90
91 Uint16 lobby_port = clamp_port(options::GetInt("MultiplayerInternetLobbyPort"), 12347);
92 out.lobby = host + ":" + std::to_string(lobby_port);
93 Uint16 udp_port = clamp_port(options::GetInt("MultiplayerInternetUdpRelayPort"), 12348);
94 Uint16 tcp_port = clamp_port(options::GetInt("MultiplayerInternetTcpRelayPort"), 12349);
95 out.udp_relay = host + ":" + std::to_string(udp_port);
96 out.tcp_relay = host + ":" + std::to_string(tcp_port);
97 return out;
98 }
99
100 std::string multiplayer_server_host_from_options() {
101 std::string host = options::GetString("MultiplayerLobbyServer");
102 if (host.empty())
103 host = "CHANGEME";
104 std::string::size_type port_sep = host.rfind(':');
105 if (port_sep != std::string::npos)
106 host = host.substr(0, port_sep);
107 return host;
108 }
109
110 bool proxy_player_info(lev::Proxy *proxy, unsigned &players, bool &optimized) {
111 if (!proxy)
112 return false;
113 try {
114 proxy->loadMetadata(true);
115 } catch (XLevelLoading &) {
116 return false;
117 }
118 bool network = proxy->hasNetworkMode();
119 bool single = proxy->hasSingleMode();
120 if (!network && !single)
121 return false;
122 optimized = network;
123 players = network ? proxy->getNetworkPlayers() : 1;
124 if (players < 1)
125 players = 1;
126 return true;
127 }
128}

305void MultiplayerMenu::on_action(gui::Widget *w) {
306 if (w == levelwidget) {
307 refresh_selection();
308 if (internet_mode) {
309 if (!internet_in_room) {
310 show_info(_("Create or join a room to start."));
311 return;
312 }
313 if (!internet_is_host) {
314 show_info(_("Waiting for host."));
315 return;
316 }
317 multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart start = multiplayer::BuildStartMessage(
318 selected_level_id, desired_players(), filter_min_players);
319 std::string error;
320 std::string server = multiplayer_server_host_from_options();
321 std::string room = room_field ? room_field->getText() : "";
322 InternetServers servers = resolve_internet_servers(server);
323 if (!multiplayer::InternetStartRoom(servers.lobby.empty() ? server : servers.lobby,
324 room, start, error)) {
325 show_info(error.empty() ? _("Failed to start room.") : error);
326 return;
327 }
328 if (!multiplayer::StartHostSession(start)) {
329 show_info(_("Failed to start multiplayer session."));
330 return;
331 }
332 multiplayer::LobbyStop();
333 game::StartGame();
334 multiplayer::LobbyStart();
335 rebuild_index();
336 refresh_selection();
337 draw_all();
338 return;
339 }
340 if (!can_start()) {
341 show_info(_("Need matching players to start."));
342 return;
343 }
344 multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart start = multiplayer::BuildStartMessage(
345 selected_level_id, desired_players(), filter_min_players);
346 if (!multiplayer::StartHostSession(start)) {
347 show_info(_("Failed to start multiplayer session."));
348 return;
349 }
350 // Start listening before broadcasting the start message to avoid a race
351 // where clients attempt to connect before the host socket is bound.
352 multiplayer::LobbyBroadcastStart(start);
353 multiplayer::LobbyStop();
354 game::StartGame();
355 multiplayer::LobbyStart();
356 rebuild_index();
357 refresh_selection();
358 draw_all();
359 return;
360 }
361 if (w == levelpack_button) {
362 if (internet_mode && internet_in_room && !internet_is_host) {
363 show_info(_("Waiting for host."));
364 return;
365 }
366 if (!selected_pack_name.empty())
367 lev::Index::setCurrentIndex(selected_pack_name);
368 LevelPackMenu menu(true);
369 menu.manage();
370 lev::Index *current = lev::Index::getCurrentIndex();
371 if (current) {
372 selected_pack_name = current->getName();
373 previous_index_name = selected_pack_name;
374 previous_index_pos = current->getCurrentPosition();
375 }
376 if (!lev::Index::setCurrentIndex(lobby_index->getName()))
377 return;
378 rebuild_index();
379 refresh_selection();
380 invalidate_all();
381 return;
382 }
383 if (w == filter_button) {
384 if (internet_mode && internet_in_room && !internet_is_host) {
385 show_info(_("Waiting for host."));
386 return;
387 }
388 unsigned players = desired_players();
389 if (filter_min_players >= players)
390 filter_min_players = 1;
391 else
392 filter_min_players += 1;
393 update_filter_button();
394 rebuild_index();
395 refresh_selection();
396 invalidate_all();
397 return;
398 }
399 if (w == mode_button) {
400 set_internet_mode(!internet_mode);
401 rebuild_index();
402 refresh_selection();
403 invalidate_all();
404 return;
405 }
406 if (w == create_room_button) {
407 if (!room_field || room_field->getText().empty()) {
408 show_info(_("please choose room code"));
409 return;
410 }
411 unsigned players = desired_players();
412 std::string server = multiplayer_server_host_from_options();
413 std::string room_code = room_field ? room_field->getText() : "";
414 InternetServers servers = resolve_internet_servers(server);
415 if (servers.lobby.empty()) {
416 show_info(_("Invalid server address."));
417 return;
418 }
419 multiplayer::SetRelayServer(servers.udp_relay);
420 multiplayer::SetTcpRelayServer(servers.tcp_relay);
421 multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart start = multiplayer::BuildStartMessage(
422 selected_level_id, players, filter_min_players);
423 std::string error;
424 if (!multiplayer::InternetCreateRoom(servers.lobby, room_code, start, error)) {
425 show_info(error.empty() ? _("Failed to create room.") : error);
426 return;
427 }
428 internet_room_code = room_code;
429 internet_start = start;
430 internet_start_valid = true;
431 internet_in_room = true;
432 internet_is_host = true;
433 internet_connecting = false;
434 internet_player_count = 1;
435 update_internet_layout();
436 show_info(_("Room created. Click a level to start."));
437 return;
438 }
439 if (w == join_room_button) {
440 std::string server = multiplayer_server_host_from_options();
441 std::string room = room_field ? room_field->getText() : "";
442 if (room.empty()) {
443 show_info(_("please choose room code"));
444 return;
445 }
446 InternetServers servers = resolve_internet_servers(server);
447 if (servers.lobby.empty()) {
448 show_info(_("Invalid server address."));
449 return;
450 }
451 multiplayer::SetRelayServer(servers.udp_relay);
452 multiplayer::SetTcpRelayServer(servers.tcp_relay);
453 multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart start;
454 std::string host_ip;
455 std::string error;
456 unsigned player_count = 0;
457 if (!multiplayer::InternetJoinRoom(servers.lobby, room, start, host_ip, player_count, error)) {
458 show_info(error.empty() ? _("Failed to join room.") : error);
459 return;
460 }
461 internet_room_code = room;
462 internet_in_room = true;
463 internet_is_host = false;
464 internet_connecting = false;
465 internet_player_count = player_count > 0 ? player_count : 1;
466 update_internet_layout();
467 internet_poll_timer = 0.0;
468 show_info(_("Waiting for host."));
469 return;
470 }
471 if (w == leave_room_button) {
472 std::string server = multiplayer_server_host_from_options();
473 std::string room = room_field ? room_field->getText() : "";
474 InternetServers servers = resolve_internet_servers(server);
475 std::string error;
476 multiplayer::InternetLeaveRoom(servers.lobby.empty() ? server : servers.lobby, room, error);
477 internet_in_room = false;
478 internet_start_valid = false;
479 internet_room_code.clear();
480 internet_is_host = false;
481 internet_connecting = false;
482 internet_player_count = 1;
483 update_internet_layout();
484 show_info(_("Left room."));
485 return;
486 }
487 if (w == back_button) {
488 Menu::quit();
489 return;
490 }
491}

498void MultiplayerMenu::tick(double dtime) {
499 update_filter_button();
500 if (!internet_mode) {
501 multiplayer::LobbyTick(dtime);
502 unsigned lobby_size = multiplayer::LobbySize();
503 if (lobby_size != last_lobby_size) {
504 last_lobby_size = lobby_size;
505 rebuild_index();
506 refresh_selection();
507 invalidate_all();
508 }
509
510 multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart start;
511 std::string host_ip;
512 if (multiplayer::LobbyPollStart(start, host_ip)) {
513 filter_min_players = start.filter_optimized;
514 update_filter_button();
515 selected_level_id = start.level_id;
516 select_pack_for_level(start.level_id);
517 rebuild_index();
518 if (!set_level_by_id(start.level_id)) {
519 show_info(_("Selected level not available."));
520 } else if (!multiplayer::StartClientSession(start, host_ip)) {
521 show_info(_("Failed to join host."));
522 } else {
523 switch (multiplayer::ActiveTransport()) {
524 case multiplayer::TransportKind::TCP_RELAY:
525 show_info(_("Using TCP relay (higher latency)."));
526 break;
527 case multiplayer::TransportKind::UDP_RELAY:
528 show_info(_("Using UDP relay."));
529 break;
530 case multiplayer::TransportKind::DIRECT:
531 show_info(_("Using direct connection."));
532 break;
533 default:
534 break;
535 }
536 multiplayer::LobbyStop();
537 game::StartGame();
538 multiplayer::LobbyStart();
539 rebuild_index();
540 draw_all();
541 }
542 refresh_selection();
543 }
544 } else {
545 if (internet_in_room) {
546 internet_poll_timer += dtime;
547 if (internet_poll_timer >= 0.2) {
548 internet_poll_timer = 0.0;
549 std::string server = multiplayer_server_host_from_options();
550 std::string room = room_field ? room_field->getText() : "";
551 InternetServers servers = resolve_internet_servers(server);
552 multiplayer::protocol::LobbyStart start;
553 std::string host_ip;
554 std::string error;
555 bool started = false;
556 unsigned player_count = 0;
557 if (multiplayer::InternetPollRoom(servers.lobby.empty() ? server : servers.lobby,
558 room, start, host_ip,
559 started, player_count, error)) {
560 if (player_count > 0 && player_count != internet_player_count) {
561 internet_player_count = player_count;
562 update_players();
563 invalidate_all();
564 }
565 if (started && !internet_is_host) {
566 internet_connecting = true;
567 update_internet_layout();
568 filter_min_players = start.filter_optimized;
569 update_filter_button();
570 selected_level_id = start.level_id;
571 select_pack_for_level(start.level_id);
572 rebuild_index();
573 if (!set_level_by_id(start.level_id)) {
574 show_info(_("Selected level not available."));
575 internet_connecting = false;
576 update_internet_layout();
577 } else if (!multiplayer::StartClientSession(start, host_ip)) {
578 show_info(_("Failed to join host."));
579 internet_connecting = false;
580 update_internet_layout();
581 } else {
582 switch (multiplayer::ActiveTransport()) {
583 case multiplayer::TransportKind::TCP_RELAY:
584 show_info(_("Using TCP relay (higher latency)."));
585 break;
586 case multiplayer::TransportKind::UDP_RELAY:
587 show_info(_("Using UDP relay."));
588 break;
589 case multiplayer::TransportKind::DIRECT:
590 show_info(_("Using direct connection."));
591 break;
592 default:
593 break;
594 }
595 internet_connecting = false;
596 multiplayer::LobbyStop();
597 game::StartGame();
598 multiplayer::LobbyStart();
599 rebuild_index();
600 draw_all();
601 }
602 refresh_selection();
603 }
604 } else if (!error.empty() && error != "waiting") {
605 show_info(error);
606 }
607 }
608 }
609 }
610
611 update_players();
612 refresh_selection();
613
614 if (info_ttl > 0.0) {
615 info_ttl -= dtime;
616 if (info_ttl <= 0.0)
617 info_label->set_text("");
618 }
619}

621void MultiplayerMenu::rebuild_index() {
622 if (!lobby_index)
623 return;
624 std::string keep = selected_level_id;
625 lobby_index->clear();
626 unsigned desired_players_count = desired_players();
627 unsigned min_players = filter_min_players;
628 if (min_players < 1)
629 min_players = 1;
630 if (min_players > desired_players_count)
631 min_players = desired_players_count;
632
633 lev::Index *pack_index = nullptr;
634 if (!selected_pack_name.empty())
635 pack_index = lev::Index::findIndex(selected_pack_name);
636 if (!pack_index)
637 pack_index = lev::Index::getCurrentIndex();
638 if (!pack_index) {
639 if (min_players == desired_players_count) {
640 info_label->set_text(ecl::strf(_("No %u player levels are in this level pack"),
641 desired_players_count));
642 } else {
643 info_label->set_text(ecl::strf(_("No %u-%u player levels are in this level pack"),
644 min_players, desired_players_count));
645 }
646 info_ttl = -1.0;
647 lev::Index::setCurrentIndex(lobby_index->getName());
648 levelwidget->syncFromIndexMgr();
649 return;
650 }
651
652 std::vector<lev::Proxy *> proxies;
653 if (pack_index) {
654 proxies.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(pack_index->size()));
655 for (int i = 0; i < pack_index->size(); ++i) {
656 if (lev::Proxy *proxy = pack_index->getProxy(i))
657 proxies.push_back(proxy);
658 }
659 }
660
661 std::vector<lev::Proxy *> filtered;
662 filtered.reserve(proxies.size());
663 lev::RatingManager *ratings = lev::RatingManager::instance();
664 for (auto *proxy : proxies) {
665 unsigned players = 0;
666 bool optimized = false;
667 if (!proxy_player_info(proxy, players, optimized))
668 continue;
669 if (players < min_players || players > desired_players_count)
670 continue;
671 filtered.push_back(proxy);
672 }
673
674 std::sort(filtered.begin(), filtered.end(),
675 [ratings](lev::Proxy *a, lev::Proxy *b) {
676 short da = ratings->getDifficulty(a);
677 short db = ratings->getDifficulty(b);
678 if (da != db)
679 return da < db;
680 const std::string &ta = a->getTitle();
681 const std::string &tb = b->getTitle();
682 if (ta != tb)
683 return ta < tb;
684 return a->getNormLevelPath() < b->getNormLevelPath();
685 });
686
687 for (auto *proxy : filtered)
688 lobby_index->appendProxy(proxy);
689
690 if (lobby_index->size() == 0)
691 selected_level_id.clear();
692
693 if (filtered.empty()) {
694 if (min_players == desired_players_count) {
695 info_label->set_text(ecl::strf(_("No %u player levels are in this level pack"),
696 desired_players_count));
697 } else {
698 info_label->set_text(ecl::strf(_("No %u-%u player levels are in this level pack"),
699 min_players, desired_players_count));
700 }
701 info_ttl = -1.0;
702 } else if (info_ttl < 0.0) {
703 info_label->set_text("");
704 info_ttl = 0.0;
705 }
706
707 lev::Index::setCurrentIndex(lobby_index->getName());
708 if (!keep.empty())
709 set_level_by_id(keep);
710 levelwidget->syncFromIndexMgr();
711}

754void MultiplayerMenu::set_internet_mode(bool enabled) {
755 if (!enabled && internet_in_room) {
756 std::string server = multiplayer_server_host_from_options();
757 std::string room = room_field ? room_field->getText() : "";
758 InternetServers servers = resolve_internet_servers(server);
759 std::string error;
760 multiplayer::InternetLeaveRoom(servers.lobby.empty() ? server : servers.lobby, room, error);
761 internet_in_room = false;
762 internet_start_valid = false;
763 internet_room_code.clear();
764 internet_is_host = false;
765 internet_connecting = false;
766 internet_player_count = 1;
767 }
768 internet_mode = enabled;
769 update_mode_button();
770 update_internet_layout();
771 if (internet_mode)
772 multiplayer::LobbyStop();
773 else
774 multiplayer::LobbyStart();
775}

777void MultiplayerMenu::update_internet_layout() {
778 int offscreen = -10000;
779 int x = internet_mode ? internet_form_x : offscreen;
780 int y = internet_mode ? internet_form_y : offscreen;
781 bool show_levels = internet_mode && internet_in_room && internet_is_host;
782 bool show_wait = internet_mode && !show_levels;
783 if (!internet_mode) {
784 room_label->move(offscreen, offscreen);
785 room_field->move(offscreen, offscreen);
786 players_label->move(offscreen, offscreen);
787 players_field->move(offscreen, offscreen);
788 internet_buttons->set_area(Rect(offscreen, offscreen,
789 internet_buttons->get_w(),
790 internet_buttons->get_h()));
791 internet_leave_buttons->set_area(Rect(offscreen, offscreen,
792 internet_leave_buttons->get_w(),
793 internet_leave_buttons->get_h()));
794 levelwidget->set_area(level_area);
795 waiting_label->move(offscreen, offscreen);
796 invalidate_all();
797 return;
798 }
799 if (show_levels) {
800 levelwidget->set_area(level_area);
801 waiting_label->move(offscreen, offscreen);
802 } else {
803 levelwidget->set_area(Rect(offscreen, offscreen, level_area.w, level_area.h));
804 if (!internet_in_room)
805 waiting_label->set_text(_("Create or join a room."));
806 else if (internet_connecting)
807 waiting_label->set_text(_("Connecting..."));
808 else
809 waiting_label->set_text(_("Waiting for host..."));
810 waiting_label->move(level_area.x, level_area.y + level_area.h / 2 - 10);
811 }
812 room_label->move(x, y);
813 room_field->move(x, y + room_label->get_h());
814 players_label->move(offscreen, offscreen);
815 players_field->move(offscreen, offscreen);
816 int buttons_w = internet_buttons->get_w();
817 int buttons_h = internet_buttons->get_h();
818 int leave_w = internet_leave_buttons->get_w();
819 int leave_h = internet_leave_buttons->get_h();
820 internet_buttons->set_area(Rect(internet_in_room ? offscreen : internet_buttons_x,
821 internet_in_room ? offscreen : internet_buttons_y,
822 buttons_w, buttons_h));
823 internet_leave_buttons->set_area(Rect(internet_in_room ? internet_buttons_x : offscreen,
824 internet_in_room ? internet_buttons_y : offscreen,
825 leave_w, leave_h));
826 bool lock_fields = internet_in_room;
827 room_field->set_locked(lock_fields);
828 create_room_button->set_text(N_("Create Room"));
829 invalidate_all();
830}

832unsigned MultiplayerMenu::desired_players() const {
833 if (!internet_mode)
834 return multiplayer::LobbySize() == 0 ? 1 : multiplayer::LobbySize();
835 if (internet_in_room && internet_player_count > 0)
836 return internet_player_count;
837 unsigned players = 0;
838 if (parse_players_field(players))
839 return players;
840 return 2;
841}

843bool MultiplayerMenu::parse_players_field(unsigned &players) const {
844 if (!players_field)
845 return false;
846 std::string text = players_field->getText();
847 if (text.empty())
848 return false;
849 char *end = nullptr;
850 long value = std::strtol(text.c_str(), &end, 10);
851 if (!end || *end != '\0')
852 return false;
853 if (value < 1)
854 value = 1;
855 if (value > static_cast<long>(input::kMaxPlayers))
856 value = input::kMaxPlayers;
857 players = static_cast<unsigned>(value);
858 return true;
859}

861void MultiplayerMenu::update_players() {
862 std::vector<multiplayer::LobbyPeer> peers;
863 if (internet_mode) {
864 unsigned count = internet_player_count > 0 ? internet_player_count : 1;
865 multiplayer::LobbyPeer self;
866 self.name = "Player";
867 self.is_self = true;
868 peers.push_back(self);
869 for (unsigned i = 1; i < count; ++i) {
870 multiplayer::LobbyPeer peer;
871 peer.name = "Player";
872 peer.is_self = false;
873 peers.push_back(peer);
874 }
875 } else {
876 peers = multiplayer::LobbyPeers();
877 std::sort(peers.begin(), peers.end(),
878 [](const multiplayer::LobbyPeer &a, const multiplayer::LobbyPeer &b) {
879 if (a.is_self != b.is_self)
880 return a.is_self;
881 return a.name < b.name;
882 });
883 }
884 for (size_t i = 0; i < player_labels.size(); ++i) {
885 if (i < peers.size()) {
886 std::string label = peers[i].name;
887 if (peers[i].is_self) {
888 label += " (you)";
889 }
890 player_labels[i]->set_text(label);
891 } else {
892 player_labels[i]->set_text("");
893 }
894 }
895}

897bool MultiplayerMenu::can_start() const {

899 return false;
900 if (required_players() > input::kMaxPlayers)
901 return false;
902 if (internet_mode)
903 return desired_players() >= required_players();
904 return multiplayer::LobbySize() >= required_players();

915 return 1;
916 return players;

A src/input.cc

Where it is used: Tick-based input queue used by lockstep.
What changed:
  • Collects per-player inputs (mouseforce, rotate, activate) indexed by tick+player.
  • Provides deterministic consumption at simulation step boundaries.
  • Exposes tick gating to block physics ticks while inputs are missing.
diff --git a/src/input.cc b/src/input.cc
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..776218ec
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/input.cc
Notes
  • Lockstep integration: simulation ticks are gated on input availability and consume one input frame per player.
@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
1#include "input.hh"
2
3#include <bitset>
4#include <map>
5
6namespace enigma {
7namespace input {
8
9namespace {
10
11struct TickInputs {
12 std::array<PlayerInput, kMaxPlayers> inputs;
13 std::bitset<kMaxPlayers> present;
14};
15
16bool g_networked = false;
17unsigned g_expected_players = 1;
18uint32_t g_current_tick = 0;
19std::array<PlayerInput, kMaxPlayers> g_local_pending;
20std::map<uint32_t, TickInputs> g_queue;
21
22PlayerInput empty_input() {
23 return PlayerInput();
24}
25
26bool valid_player(unsigned player) {
27 return player < kMaxPlayers;
28}
29
30} // namespace
31
32void Reset() {
33 g_current_tick = 0;
34 g_queue.clear();
35 g_networked = false;
36 g_expected_players = 1;
37 for (auto &pending : g_local_pending)
38 pending = PlayerInput();
39}
40
41void SetNetworked(bool enabled) {
42 g_networked = enabled;
43}
44
45bool IsNetworked() {
46 return g_networked;
47}
48
49void SetExpectedPlayers(unsigned count) {
50 g_expected_players = count;
51}
52
53unsigned ExpectedPlayers() {
54 return g_expected_players;
55}
56
57uint32_t CurrentTick() {
58 return g_current_tick;
59}
60
61void SubmitMouseForce(unsigned player, const ecl::V2 &force) {
62 if (!valid_player(player))
63 return;
64 g_local_pending[player].mouse_force += force;
65}
66
67void SubmitRotateInventory(unsigned player, int dir) {
68 if (!valid_player(player))
69 return;
70 g_local_pending[player].rotate_steps += dir;
71}
72
73void SubmitActivateItem(unsigned player) {
74 if (!valid_player(player))
75 return;
76 g_local_pending[player].activate_count += 1;
77}
78
79PlayerInput DrainLocalPending(unsigned player) {
80 if (!valid_player(player))
81 return empty_input();
82 PlayerInput pending = g_local_pending[player];
83 g_local_pending[player] = PlayerInput();
84 return pending;
85}
86
87void EnqueueInput(uint32_t tick, unsigned player, const PlayerInput &input) {
88 if (!valid_player(player))
89 return;
90 TickInputs &slot = g_queue[tick];
91 slot.inputs[player].merge(input);
92 slot.present.set(player);
93}
94
95bool HasInput(uint32_t tick, unsigned player) {
96 if (!valid_player(player))
97 return false;
98 auto it = g_queue.find(tick);
99 if (it == g_queue.end())
100 return false;
101 return it->second.present.test(player);
102}
103
104bool PeekInput(uint32_t tick, unsigned player, PlayerInput &out) {
105 if (!valid_player(player))
106 return false;
107 auto it = g_queue.find(tick);
108 if (it == g_queue.end())
109 return false;
110 if (!it->second.present.test(player))
111 return false;
112 out = it->second.inputs[player];
113 return true;
114}
115
116bool CanAdvanceTick() {
117 if (!g_networked)
118 return true;
119 if (g_expected_players == 0)
120 return false;
121 for (unsigned player = 0; player < g_expected_players; ++player) {
122 if (!HasInput(g_current_tick, player))
123 return false;
124 }
125 return true;
126}
127
128PlayerInput ConsumeInput(uint32_t tick, unsigned player) {
129 if (!valid_player(player))
130 return empty_input();
131 if (!g_networked)
132 return DrainLocalPending(player);
133 auto it = g_queue.find(tick);
134 if (it == g_queue.end() || !it->second.present.test(player))
135 return empty_input();
136 PlayerInput input = it->second.inputs[player];
137 it->second.inputs[player] = PlayerInput();
138 it->second.present.reset(player);
139 if (it->second.present.none())
140 g_queue.erase(it);
141 return input;
142}
143
144void AdvanceTick() {
145 ++g_current_tick;
146}
147
148} // namespace input
149} // namespace enigma

142void debug_log(const char *fmt, ...) {
143 if (!debug_enabled())
144 return;
145
146#ifdef WIN32
147 // GUI-subsystem binaries often have no attached console, so stderr can be
148 // discarded. When ENIGMA_MP_DEBUG is enabled, also write to a temp log file
149 // so Windows builds remain debuggable.
150 static FILE *log_file = nullptr;
151 static bool log_file_init = false;
152 if (!log_file_init) {
153 log_file_init = true;
154 const char *tmp = std::getenv("TEMP");
155 if (!tmp || !*tmp)
156 tmp = std::getenv("TMP");
157 if (!tmp || !*tmp)
158 tmp = ".";
159 char path[1024] = {0};
160 std::snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/enigma-mp-%d.log", tmp, _getpid());
161 log_file = std::fopen(path, "a");
162 }
163#endif
164
165 va_list args;
166 va_start(args, fmt);
167 std::vfprintf(stderr, fmt, args);
168 std::fprintf(stderr, "\n");
169 std::fflush(stderr);
170#ifdef WIN32
171 if (log_file) {
172 va_list args2;
173 va_start(args2, fmt);
174 std::vfprintf(log_file, fmt, args2);
175 std::fprintf(log_file, "\n");
176 std::fflush(log_file);
177 va_end(args2);
178 }
179#endif
180 va_end(args);
181}

183static std::string address_to_ip_string(const ENetAddress &addr) {
184 // Always prefer a numeric IPv4 address here. LAN multiplayer uses this
185 // address for direct connects; reverse DNS / hostnames can fail to resolve
186 // (notably on Windows).
187 in_addr ia;
188 ia.s_addr = addr.host; // ENet stores host in network byte order.
189#ifdef WIN32
190 const char *s = inet_ntoa(ia);
191 return s ? std::string(s) : std::string();
192#else
193 char buf[INET_ADDRSTRLEN] = {0};
194 if (!inet_ntop(AF_INET, &ia, buf, sizeof(buf)))
195 return std::string();
196 return std::string(buf);
197#endif
198}

321bool screen_tiles(int &out_x, int &out_y) {

340bool is_passable_for_sight(const GridPos &pos) {
341 if (!IsInsideLevel(pos))
342 return false;
343 Floor *floor = GetFloor(pos);
344 if (!floor)
345 return false;
346 const std::string kind = floor->getKind();
347 if (kind == "fl_abyss" || kind == "fl_water" || kind == "fl_space" || kind == "fl_space_force")
348 return false;
349 if (GetStone(pos) != nullptr)
350 return false;
351 if (GetItem(pos) != nullptr)
352 return false;
353 return true;
354}

358bool is_safe_floor(const GridPos &pos) {
359 if (!is_free_floor(pos))
360 return false;

362 if (!floor)
363 return false;
364 const std::string kind = floor->getKind();
365 if (kind == "fl_swamp" || kind == "fl_thief")

370bool has_clear_sight(const GridPos &from, const GridPos &to) {
371 int x0 = from.x;
372 int y0 = from.y;
373 int x1 = to.x;
374 int y1 = to.y;
375 int dx = std::abs(x1 - x0);
376 int dy = std::abs(y1 - y0);
377 int sx = (x0 < x1) ? 1 : -1;
378 int sy = (y0 < y1) ? 1 : -1;
379 int err = dx - dy;
380
381 int x = x0;
382 int y = y0;
383 while (true) {
384 if (!(x == x0 && y == y0) && !(x == x1 && y == y1)) {
385 if (!is_passable_for_sight(GridPos(x, y)))
386 return false;
387 }
388 if (x == x1 && y == y1)
389 break;
390 int e2 = 2 * err;
391 if (e2 > -dy) {
392 err -= dy;
393 x += sx;
394 }
395 if (e2 < dx) {
396 err += dx;
397 y += sy;
398 }
399 }
400 return true;
401}
402
403bool is_free_floor(const GridPos &pos) {
404 if (!IsInsideLevel(pos))
405 return false;
406 Floor *floor = GetFloor(pos);
407 if (!floor)
408 return false;
409 const std::string kind = floor->getKind();
410 if (kind == "fl_abyss" || kind == "fl_water" || kind == "fl_space" || kind == "fl_space_force")
411 return false;
412 if (GetStone(pos) != nullptr)
413 return false;
414 if (GetItem(pos) != nullptr)
415 return false;
416 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
417 GetActorsInsideField(pos, actors);
418 if (!actors.empty())
419 return false;
420 return true;
421}

423bool is_valid_placement(const GridPos &pos, unsigned player) {
424 if (!is_free_floor(pos))
425 return false;
426 if (!placement_required_for_player(player))
427 return true;
428 unsigned base_player = player % g_session.level_players;
429 Actor *base_actor = player::GetMainActor(base_player);
430 if (!base_actor)
431 return true;
432 int tiles_x = 0;
433 int tiles_y = 0;
434 int origin_x = 0;
435 int origin_y = 0;
436 GridPos base_pos(base_actor->get_startpos());
437 if (!screen_bounds_for_base(base_pos, origin_x, origin_y, tiles_x, tiles_y))
438 return true;
439 if (pos.x < origin_x || pos.x >= origin_x + tiles_x)
440 return false;
441 if (pos.y < origin_y || pos.y >= origin_y + tiles_y)
442 return false;
443 return true;
444}

449bool find_clear_floor_near_base(const GridPos &base_pos, GridPos &out_pos) {
450 int tiles_x = 0;
451 int tiles_y = 0;
452 int origin_x = 0;
453 int origin_y = 0;
454 if (!screen_bounds_for_base(base_pos, origin_x, origin_y, tiles_x, tiles_y))
455 return false;
456 int best_dist = std::numeric_limits<int>::max();
457 bool found = false;
458 for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {
459 for (int y = origin_y; y < origin_y + tiles_y; ++y) {
460 for (int x = origin_x; x < origin_x + tiles_x; ++x) {
461 GridPos pos(x, y);
462 if (pass == 0) {
463 if (!is_safe_floor(pos))
464 continue;
465 } else {
466 if (!is_free_floor(pos))
467 continue;
468 }
469 if (!has_clear_sight(base_pos, pos))
470 continue;
471 int dx = x - base_pos.x;
472 int dy = y - base_pos.y;
473 int dist = dx * dx + dy * dy;
474 if (dist < best_dist) {
475 best_dist = dist;
476 out_pos = pos;
477 found = true;
478 }
479 }
480 }
481 if (found)
482 return true;
483 }
484 return false;
485}
486
487bool find_random_free_tile(const GridPos &base_pos, GridPos &out_pos) {
488 int tiles_x = 0;
489 int tiles_y = 0;
490 int origin_x = 0;
491 int origin_y = 0;
492 std::vector<GridPos> free_tiles;
493 if (screen_bounds_for_base(base_pos, origin_x, origin_y, tiles_x, tiles_y)) {
494 for (int y = origin_y; y < origin_y + tiles_y; ++y) {
495 for (int x = origin_x; x < origin_x + tiles_x; ++x) {
496 GridPos pos(x, y);
497 if (is_free_floor(pos))
498 free_tiles.push_back(pos);
499 }
500 }
501 if (!free_tiles.empty()) {
502 int idx = enigma::IntegerRand(0, static_cast<int>(free_tiles.size() - 1), true);
503 out_pos = free_tiles[static_cast<size_t>(idx)];
504 return true;
505 }
506 }
507 free_tiles.clear();
508 int width = Width();
509 int height = Height();
510 for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y) {
511 for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x) {
512 GridPos pos(x, y);
513 if (is_free_floor(pos))
514 free_tiles.push_back(pos);
515 }
516 }
517 if (free_tiles.empty())
518 return false;
519 int idx = enigma::IntegerRand(0, static_cast<int>(free_tiles.size() - 1), true);
520 out_pos = free_tiles[static_cast<size_t>(idx)];
521 return true;
522}

524void auto_place_extra_players() {
525 if (!g_session.host)
526 return;
527 if (g_session.level_players == 0)
528 return;
529 for (unsigned player = g_session.level_players; player < g_session.expected_players; ++player) {
530 if (!placement_required_for_player(player))
531 continue;
532 unsigned base_index = player % g_session.level_players;
533 Actor *base_actor = player::GetMainActor(base_index);
534 if (!base_actor)
535 continue;
536 GridPos base_pos(base_actor->get_startpos());
537 GridPos pos;
538 bool found = find_clear_floor_near_base(base_pos, pos);
539 if (!found)
540 found = find_random_free_tile(base_pos, pos);
541 if (!found)
542 continue;
543 protocol::PlacementPacket msg;
544 msg.restart_id = g_session.restart_id;
545 msg.player = static_cast<Uint8>(player);
546 msg.x = static_cast<Uint16>(pos.x);
547 msg.y = static_cast<Uint16>(pos.y);
548 apply_placement(player, pos);
549 if (g_session.placement_received.size() > player)
550 g_session.placement_received[player] = true;
551 broadcast_placement(msg);
552 }
553}

555void apply_placement(unsigned player, const GridPos &pos) {

560 WarpActor(actor, center[0], center[1], false);
561 actor->set_respawnpos(center);

564void broadcast_placement(const protocol::PlacementPacket &msg) {
565 if (!g_session.host || !has_remote_peers())
566 return;
567 ecl::Buffer buf;
568 protocol::encode_place(buf, msg);
569 if (!g_session.peer_players.empty()) {
570 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(), ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
571 enet_host_broadcast(g_session.host_handle, 0, packet);
572 }
573 if (!g_session.relay_players.empty())
574 broadcast_relay_payload(buf, 0);
575 if (!g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty())
576 broadcast_tcp_relay_payload(buf, 0);
577}

661void send_placement_to_host(const GridPos &pos) {
662 if (!g_session.active)
663 return;
664 protocol::PlacementPacket msg;
665 msg.restart_id = g_session.restart_id;
666 msg.player = static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.local_player);
667 msg.x = static_cast<Uint16>(pos.x);
668 msg.y = static_cast<Uint16>(pos.y);
669 if (g_session.host) {
670 if (placement_required_for_player(msg.player) && is_valid_placement(pos, msg.player)) {
671 apply_placement(msg.player, pos);
672 if (g_session.placement_received.size() > msg.player)
673 g_session.placement_received[msg.player] = true;
674 broadcast_placement(msg);
675 }
676 return;
677 }
678 ecl::Buffer buf;
679 protocol::encode_place(buf, msg);
680 client_send_payload(buf);
681}

683void add_extra_actors(unsigned level_players, unsigned expected_players) {
684 if (level_players == 0 || expected_players <= level_players)
685 return;
686 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
687 GetActors(actors);
688
689 std::vector<Actor *> base(level_players, nullptr);
690 std::vector<Actor *> fallback(level_players, nullptr);
691 Actor *any_actor = nullptr;
692
693 for (auto *actor : actors) {
694 if (!any_actor && actor->isSteerable())
695 any_actor = actor;
696 Value owner_val = actor->getAttr("owner");
697 if (owner_val.getType() == Value::NIL)
698 continue;
699 int owner = owner_val;
700 if (owner < 0 || owner >= static_cast<int>(level_players))
701 continue;
702 if (!fallback[owner])
703 fallback[owner] = actor;
704 if (!base[owner]) {
705 int controllers = actor->get_controllers();
706 if ((controllers & (1 << owner)) != 0 && actor->isSteerable())
707 base[owner] = actor;
708 }
709 }
710
711 for (unsigned i = 0; i < level_players; ++i) {
712 if (!base[i])
713 base[i] = fallback[i];
714 }
715
716 if (!any_actor) {
717 for (auto *candidate : base) {
718 if (candidate) {
719 any_actor = candidate;
720 break;
721 }
722 }
723 }
724
725 for (unsigned player = level_players; player < expected_players; ++player) {
726 unsigned base_index = (level_players > 0) ? (player % level_players) : 0;
727 Actor *base_actor = base_index < base.size() ? base[base_index] : nullptr;
728 if (!base_actor)
729 base_actor = any_actor;
730 if (!base_actor)
731 continue;
732 Actor *extra = MakeActor(base_actor->getKind().c_str());
733 if (!extra)
734 continue;
735 extra->setAttr("owner", Value(static_cast<int>(player)));
736 extra->setAttr("controllers", Value(static_cast<int>(1 << player)));
737 extra->setAttr("essential", Value(0));
738 Value color = base_actor->getAttr("color");
739 if (color.getType() != Value::NIL)
740 extra->setAttr("color", color);
741 ecl::V2 pos = base_actor->get_pos();
742 AddActor(pos[0], pos[1], extra);
743 }
744}

764bool bind_lobby_socket(ENetSocket socket, Uint16 port) {
765 int opt = 1;
766#ifdef WIN32
767 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&opt), sizeof(opt));
768#ifdef SO_REUSEPORT
769 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEPORT, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&opt), sizeof(opt));
770#endif
771 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BROADCAST, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&opt), sizeof(opt));
772 u_long mode = 1;
773 ioctlsocket(socket, FIONBIO, &mode);
774#else
775 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
776#ifdef SO_REUSEPORT
777 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEPORT, &opt, sizeof(opt));
778#endif
779 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BROADCAST, &opt, sizeof(opt));
780
781 // Make the lobby socket non-blocking. Some ENet builds do not set this by
782 // default, and a blocking recvfrom() would stall the UI loop.
783 int flags = fcntl(socket, F_GETFL, 0);
784 if (flags != -1) {
785 (void)fcntl(socket, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);
786 }
787#endif
788
789 sockaddr_in sin;
790 std::memset(&sin, 0, sizeof(sin));
791 sin.sin_family = AF_INET;
792 sin.sin_port = ENET_HOST_TO_NET_16(port);
793 sin.sin_addr.s_addr = ENET_HOST_ANY;
794 bool ok = bind(socket, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr *>(&sin), sizeof(sin)) == 0;
795 if (ok) {
796 // Make sure socket behaves consistently across ENet builds.
797 tune_enet_socket(socket, true);
798 }
799 return ok;
800}
801
802void tune_enet_socket(ENetSocket socket, bool broadcast) {
803 if (socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
804 return;
805
806 int opt = 1;
807#ifdef WIN32
808 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&opt), sizeof(opt));
809 if (broadcast)
810 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BROADCAST, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&opt), sizeof(opt));
811 u_long mode = 1;
812 ioctlsocket(socket, FIONBIO, &mode);
813#else
814 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
815 if (broadcast)
816 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BROADCAST, &opt, sizeof(opt));
817
818 // Force non-blocking behavior across ENet variants. We never want UI/game
819 // loops to block on a recvfrom()/sendto().
820 int flags = fcntl(socket, F_GETFL, 0);
821 if (flags != -1)
822 (void)fcntl(socket, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);
823#endif
824
825 // Increase buffers a bit to reduce packet loss under load.
826 int buf_sz = 1 << 20; // 1 MiB
827#ifdef WIN32
828 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVBUF, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&buf_sz), sizeof(buf_sz));
829 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&buf_sz), sizeof(buf_sz));
830#else
831 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVBUF, &buf_sz, sizeof(buf_sz));
832 setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, &buf_sz, sizeof(buf_sz));
833#endif
834}

836std::string make_id() {
837 std::random_device rd;
838 uint64_t value = (static_cast<uint64_t>(rd()) << 32) ^ static_cast<uint64_t>(rd());
839 std::ostringstream out;
840 out << std::hex << value;
841 return out.str();
842}

844bool parse_host_port(const std::string &value, std::string &host, Uint16 &port) {
845 host.clear();
846 port = kInternetLobbyPort;
847 if (value.empty())
848 return false;
849 std::string::size_type pos = value.rfind(':');
850 if (pos == std::string::npos) {
851 host = value;
852 return true;
853 }
854 host = value.substr(0, pos);
855 std::string port_str = value.substr(pos + 1);
856 if (!port_str.empty()) {
857 char *end = nullptr;
858 long parsed = std::strtol(port_str.c_str(), &end, 10);
859 if (end && *end == '\0' && parsed > 0 && parsed <= 65535)
860 port = static_cast<Uint16>(parsed);
861 }
862 if (host == "localhost" || host == "::1")
863 host = "127.0.0.1";
864 return !host.empty();
865}
866
867bool tcp_socket_valid(TcpSocket s) {
868#ifdef WIN32
869 return s != INVALID_SOCKET;
870#else
871 return s >= 0;
872#endif
873}
874
875void tcp_close(TcpSocket &s) {
876 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
877 return;
878#ifdef WIN32
879 closesocket(s);
880 s = INVALID_SOCKET;
881#else
882 close(s);
883 s = -1;
884#endif
885}
886
887bool tcp_set_nonblocking(TcpSocket s) {
888#ifdef WIN32
889 u_long mode = 1;
890 return ioctlsocket(s, FIONBIO, &mode) == 0;
891#else
892 int flags = fcntl(s, F_GETFL, 0);
893 if (flags < 0)
894 return false;
895 return fcntl(s, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK) == 0;
896#endif
897}
898
899bool tcp_send_all(TcpSocket s, const void *data, size_t len) {
900 const uint8_t *p = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(data);
901 size_t sent = 0;
902 while (sent < len) {
903#ifdef WIN32
904 int n = ::send(s, reinterpret_cast<const char *>(p + sent),
905 static_cast<int>(len - sent), 0);
906#else
907 ssize_t n = ::send(s, p + sent, len - sent, 0);
908#endif
909 if (n <= 0) {
910#ifdef WIN32
911 int err = WSAGetLastError();
912 if (err != WSAEWOULDBLOCK)
913 {
914 if (debug_enabled())
915 debug_log("mp tcp send failed err=%d", err);
916 return false;
917 }
918#else
919 if (errno != EAGAIN && errno != EWOULDBLOCK) {
920 if (debug_enabled())
921 debug_log("mp tcp send failed errno=%d (%s)", errno, strerror(errno));
922 return false;
923 }
924#endif
925 fd_set wfds;
926 FD_ZERO(&wfds);
927 FD_SET(s, &wfds);
928 timeval tv;
929 tv.tv_sec = 0;
930 tv.tv_usec = 200 * 1000;
931#ifdef WIN32
932 int sel = ::select(0, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
933#else
934 int sel = ::select(s + 1, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
935#endif
936 if (sel <= 0)
937 {
938 if (debug_enabled())
939 debug_log("mp tcp send wait timeout/err sel=%d", sel);
940 return false;
941 }
942 continue;
943 }
944 sent += static_cast<size_t>(n);
945 }
946 return true;
947}
948
949bool tcp_send_frame(TcpSocket s, const void *data, size_t len) {
950 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
951 return false;
952 if (len > (1u << 20))
953 return false;
954 uint8_t prefix[4];
955 uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(len);
956 prefix[0] = static_cast<uint8_t>(v & 0xFF);
957 prefix[1] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
958 prefix[2] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
959 prefix[3] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 24) & 0xFF);
960 return tcp_send_all(s, prefix, sizeof(prefix)) && tcp_send_all(s, data, len);
961}
962
963bool tcp_pump_recv(TcpSocket s, std::vector<uint8_t> &rx) {
964 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
965 return false;
966 uint8_t buf[4096];
967 while (true) {
968#ifdef WIN32
969 int n = ::recv(s, reinterpret_cast<char *>(buf), static_cast<int>(sizeof(buf)), 0);
970 if (n == 0)
971 return false;
972 if (n < 0) {
973 int err = WSAGetLastError();
974 if (err == WSAEWOULDBLOCK)
975 break;
976 return false;
977 }
978#else
979 ssize_t n = ::recv(s, buf, sizeof(buf), 0);
980 if (n == 0)
981 return false;
982 if (n < 0) {
983 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)
984 break;
985 return false;
986 }
987#endif
988 rx.insert(rx.end(), buf, buf + n);
989 if (static_cast<size_t>(n) < sizeof(buf))
990 break;
991 }
992 return true;
993}
994
995bool tcp_try_extract_frame(std::vector<uint8_t> &rx, uint32_t &pending_len,
996 std::vector<uint8_t> &out) {
997 out.clear();
998 if (pending_len == 0) {
999 if (rx.size() < 4)
1000 return false;
1001 uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(rx[0]) |
1002 (static_cast<uint32_t>(rx[1]) << 8) |
1003 (static_cast<uint32_t>(rx[2]) << 16) |
1004 (static_cast<uint32_t>(rx[3]) << 24);
1005 rx.erase(rx.begin(), rx.begin() + 4);
1006 if (v == 0 || v > (1u << 20)) {
1007 pending_len = 0;
1008 rx.clear();
1009 return false;
1010 }
1011 pending_len = v;
1012 }
1013 if (rx.size() < pending_len)
1014 return false;
1015 out.assign(rx.begin(), rx.begin() + pending_len);
1016 rx.erase(rx.begin(), rx.begin() + pending_len);
1017 pending_len = 0;
1018 return true;
1019}
1020
1021bool tcp_connect_timeout(const std::string &host, Uint16 port, Uint32 timeout_ms,
1022 TcpSocket &out) {
1023 out = kInvalidTcpSocket;
1024 if (host.empty() || port == 0)
1025 return false;
1026 addrinfo hints;
1027 std::memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
1028 hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
1029 hints.ai_family = AF_UNSPEC;
1030
1031 addrinfo *res = nullptr;
1032 std::string port_str = std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned>(port));
1033 if (getaddrinfo(host.c_str(), port_str.c_str(), &hints, &res) != 0)
1034 return false;
1035
1036 Uint32 start = SDL_GetTicks();
1037 for (addrinfo *ai = res; ai != nullptr; ai = ai->ai_next) {
1038 if (SDL_GetTicks() - start > timeout_ms)
1039 break;
1040#ifdef WIN32
1041 TcpSocket s = ::socket(ai->ai_family, ai->ai_socktype, ai->ai_protocol);
1042#else
1043 TcpSocket s = ::socket(ai->ai_family, ai->ai_socktype, ai->ai_protocol);
1044#endif
1045 if (!tcp_socket_valid(s))
1046 continue;
1047 if (!tcp_set_nonblocking(s)) {
1048 tcp_close(s);
1049 continue;
1050 }
1051 int rc = ::connect(s, ai->ai_addr, static_cast<int>(ai->ai_addrlen));
1052#ifdef WIN32
1053 if (rc == 0) {
1054 out = s;
1055 freeaddrinfo(res);
1056 return true;
1057 }
1058 int err = WSAGetLastError();
1059 if (err != WSAEWOULDBLOCK && err != WSAEINPROGRESS) {
1060 tcp_close(s);
1061 continue;
1062 }
1063#else
1064 if (rc == 0) {
1065 out = s;
1066 freeaddrinfo(res);
1067 return true;
1068 }
1069 if (errno != EINPROGRESS) {
1070 tcp_close(s);
1071 continue;
1072 }
1073#endif
1074 Uint32 now = SDL_GetTicks();
1075 Uint32 remaining = (now - start < timeout_ms) ? (timeout_ms - (now - start)) : 0;
1076 timeval tv;
1077 tv.tv_sec = static_cast<long>(remaining / 1000);
1078 tv.tv_usec = static_cast<long>((remaining % 1000) * 1000);
1079 fd_set wfds;
1080 FD_ZERO(&wfds);
1081 FD_SET(s, &wfds);
1082#ifdef WIN32
1083 int sel = ::select(0, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
1084#else
1085 int sel = ::select(s + 1, nullptr, &wfds, nullptr, &tv);
1086#endif
1087 if (sel <= 0) {
1088 tcp_close(s);
1089 continue;
1090 }
1091 int so_error = 0;
1092#ifdef WIN32
1093 int slen = sizeof(so_error);
1094#else
1095 socklen_t slen = sizeof(so_error);
1096#endif
1097 if (getsockopt(s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR,
1098#ifdef WIN32
1099 reinterpret_cast<char *>(&so_error),
1100#else
1101 &so_error,
1102#endif
1103 &slen) != 0) {
1104 tcp_close(s);
1105 continue;
1106 }
1107 if (so_error == 0) {
1108 out = s;
1109 freeaddrinfo(res);
1110 return true;
1111 }
1112 tcp_close(s);
1113 }
1114
1115 freeaddrinfo(res);
1116 return false;
1117}
1118
1119bool internet_exchange(const std::string &server, const ecl::Buffer &request,
1120 ecl::Buffer &response, std::string &error) {
1121 std::string host;
1122 Uint16 port = 0;
1123 if (!parse_host_port(server, host, port)) {
1124 error = "Invalid server address.";
1125 return false;
1126 }
1127
1128 ENetAddress addr;
1129 if (enet_address_set_host(&addr, host.c_str()) != 0) {
1130 error = "Failed to resolve server.";
1131 return false;
1132 }
1133 addr.port = port;
1134
1135 ENetSocket socket = enet_socket_create_compat(ENET_SOCKET_TYPE_DATAGRAM);
1136 if (socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
1137 error = "Failed to open socket.";
1138 return false;
1139 }
1140 ENetBuffer eb;
1141 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(request.data());
1142 eb.dataLength = request.size();
1143 if (enet_socket_send(socket, &addr, &eb, 1) <= 0) {
1144 enet_socket_destroy(socket);
1145 error = "Failed to send request.";
1146 return false;
1147 }
1148
1149 char data[1024];
1150 ENetBuffer rb;
1151 rb.data = data;
1152 rb.dataLength = sizeof(data);
1153 Uint32 start = SDL_GetTicks();
1154 while (SDL_GetTicks() - start < 1500) {
1155 enet_uint32 condition = ENET_SOCKET_WAIT_RECEIVE;
1156 enet_socket_wait(socket, &condition, 50);
1157 if ((condition & ENET_SOCKET_WAIT_RECEIVE) == 0)
1158 continue;
1159 ENetAddress src;
1160 int received = enet_socket_receive(socket, &src, &rb, 1);
1161 if (received > 0) {
1162 response.assign(data, static_cast<ecl::Buffer::size_t>(received));
1163 enet_socket_destroy(socket);
1164 return true;
1165 }
1166 }
1167
1168 enet_socket_destroy(socket);
1169 error = "No response from server.";
1170 return false;
1171}
1172
1173void encode_relay_header(ecl::Buffer &buf, RelayMessageType type, Uint32 session_id,
1174 Uint32 client_id) {
1175 buf << Uint32(kRelayMagic) << Uint8(kRelayVersion) << Uint8(type)
1176 << Uint32(session_id) << Uint32(client_id);
1177}
1178
1179bool decode_relay_header(const char *data, size_t len, RelayMessageType &type,
1180 Uint32 &session_id, Uint32 &client_id,
1181 const char *&payload, size_t &payload_len) {
1182 ecl::Buffer buf;
1183 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1184 Uint32 magic = 0;
1185 Uint8 version = 0;
1186 Uint8 raw_type = 0;
1187 if (!(buf >> magic >> version >> raw_type >> session_id >> client_id))
1188 return false;
1189 if (magic != kRelayMagic || version != kRelayVersion)
1190 return false;
1191 type = static_cast<RelayMessageType>(raw_type);
1192 size_t offset = static_cast<size_t>(buf.get_rpos());
1193 if (offset > len)
1194 return false;
1195 payload = data + offset;
1196 payload_len = len - offset;
1197 return true;
1198}
1199
1200std::string encode_hex(const char *data, size_t len) {
1201 static const char *hex = "0123456789ABCDEF";
1202 std::string out;
1203 out.reserve(len * 2);
1204 for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
1205 unsigned char c = static_cast<unsigned char>(data[i]);
1206 out.push_back(hex[(c >> 4) & 0xF]);
1207 out.push_back(hex[c & 0xF]);
1208 }
1209 return out;
1210}
1211
1212bool decode_hex(const std::string &text, ecl::Buffer &out) {
1213 if (text.empty() || (text.size() % 2) != 0)
1214 return false;
1215 out.clear();
1216 for (size_t i = 0; i < text.size(); i += 2) {
1217 char hi = text[i];
1218 char lo = text[i + 1];
1219 auto hexval = [](char c) -> int {
1220 if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
1221 return c - '0';
1222 if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F')
1223 return 10 + (c - 'A');
1224 if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f')
1225 return 10 + (c - 'a');
1226 return -1;
1227 };
1228 int h = hexval(hi);
1229 int l = hexval(lo);
1230 if (h < 0 || l < 0)
1231 return false;
1232 char byte = static_cast<char>((h << 4) | l);
1233 out.write(byte);
1234 }
1235 return true;
1236}

1252void send_lobby_announce() {
1253 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
1254 return;
1255 protocol::LobbyAnnounce msg;
1256 msg.id = g_lobby.local_id;
1257 msg.name = g_lobby.local_name;
1258 msg.level_id = g_lobby.selected_level;
1259 msg.player_count = static_cast<Uint8>(g_lobby.peers.size() + 1);
1260
1261 ecl::Buffer buf;
1262 protocol::encode_lobby_announce(buf, msg);
1263
1264 ENetAddress addr;
1265 addr.host = ENET_HOST_BROADCAST;
1266 addr.port = kLobbyPort;
1267 ENetBuffer eb;
1268 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(buf.data());
1269 eb.dataLength = buf.size();
1270 enet_socket_send(g_lobby.socket, &addr, &eb, 1);
1271}
1272
1273void poll_lobby_socket() {
1274 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
1275 return;
1276 ENetAddress src;
1277 char data[512];
1278 ENetBuffer buffer;
1279 buffer.data = data;
1280 buffer.dataLength = sizeof(data);
1281
1282 while (true) {
1283 int received = enet_socket_receive(g_lobby.socket, &src, &buffer, 1);
1284 if (received <= 0)
1285 break;
1286
1287 std::string ip = address_to_ip_string(src);
1288 if (ip.empty())
1289 continue;
1290
1291 ecl::Buffer buf;
1292 buf.assign(data, static_cast<ecl::Buffer::size_t>(received));
1293 protocol::LobbyAnnounce announce;
1294 if (protocol::decode_lobby_announce(buf, announce)) {
1295 if (announce.id == g_lobby.local_id)
1296 continue;
1297 LobbyPeerEntry &entry = g_lobby.peers[announce.id];
1298 entry.peer.id = announce.id;
1299 entry.peer.name = announce.name;
1300 entry.peer.level_id = announce.level_id;
1301 entry.peer.address = ip;
1302 entry.peer.is_self = false;
1303 entry.last_seen = g_lobby.time;
1304 continue;
1305 }
1306
1307 buf.assign(data, static_cast<ecl::Buffer::size_t>(received));
1308 protocol::LobbyStart start;
1309 if (protocol::decode_lobby_start(buf, start)) {
1310 if (start.host_id == g_lobby.local_id)
1311 continue;
1312 if (g_session.active)
1313 continue;
1314 if (start.session_id == g_lobby.last_session_id)
1315 continue;
1316 g_lobby.pending_start = start;
1317 g_lobby.pending_host_ip = ip;
1318 g_lobby.has_pending_start = true;
1319 g_lobby.last_session_id = start.session_id;
1320 }
1321 }
1322}

1324void cleanup_lobby_peers() {

1326 if (g_lobby.time - it->second.last_seen > kPeerTimeout)
1327 it = g_lobby.peers.erase(it);

1329 ++it;
1330 }
1331}

1398
1399bool client_send_payload(const ecl::Buffer &payload) {
1400 if (g_session.host)
1401 return false;
1402 if (g_session.server_peer) {
1403 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload.data(), payload.size(),
1404 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
1405 enet_peer_send(g_session.server_peer, 0, packet);
1406 if (g_session.host_handle)
1407 enet_host_flush(g_session.host_handle);
1408 return true;
1409 }
1410 if (g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY &&
1411 tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket)) {
1412 bool ok = tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, payload.data(), payload.size());
1413 if (!ok && debug_enabled())
1414 debug_log("mp client: tcp relay send failed (len=%u)", (unsigned)payload.size());
1415 return ok;
1416 }
1417 return false;

1479void send_resync_state(ENetPeer *peer) {

1491 protocol::ResyncActorState entry;

1493 entry.actor_id = static_cast<Uint16>(get_id(actor));
1494 Value owner = actor->getAttr("owner");
1495 if (owner.getType() != Value::NIL)
1496 entry.owner = static_cast<Uint16>(static_cast<int>(owner));
1497 else
1498 entry.owner = static_cast<Uint16>(0xFFFF);
1499 entry.x = static_cast<float>(actor->get_pos()[0]);
1500 entry.y = static_cast<float>(actor->get_pos()[1]);
1501 entry.vx = static_cast<float>(actor->get_vel()[0]);
1502 entry.vy = static_cast<float>(actor->get_vel()[1]);
1503 state.actors.push_back(entry);
1504 }
1505 ecl::Buffer buf;
1506 protocol::encode_resync_state(buf, state);
1507 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(), ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
1508 enet_peer_send(peer, 0, packet);
1509}

1573void apply_resync_state(const protocol::ResyncState &state) {
1574 if (!g_session.active)
1575 return;
1576 if (state.epoch != g_session.input_epoch)
1577 return;
1578 server::RandomState = state.random_state;
1579
1580 std::unordered_map<Uint32, Actor *> by_id;
1581 std::vector<Actor *> actors;
1582 GetActors(actors);
1583 by_id.reserve(actors.size());
1584 for (Actor *actor : actors)
1585 by_id[static_cast<Uint32>(actor->getId())] = actor;
1586
1587 for (const auto &entry : state.actors) {
1588 Actor *actor = nullptr;
1589 auto it = by_id.find(entry.object_id);
1590 if (it != by_id.end()) {
1591 actor = it->second;
1592 } else {
1593 int desired_owner = (entry.owner == 0xFFFF)
1594 ? -1
1595 : static_cast<int>(entry.owner);
1596 for (Actor *candidate : actors) {
1597 if (get_id(candidate) == entry.actor_id) {
1598 Value owner = candidate->getAttr("owner");
1599 int candidate_owner = (owner.getType() != Value::NIL)
1600 ? static_cast<int>(owner)
1601 : -1;
1602 if (candidate_owner == desired_owner) {
1603 actor = candidate;
1604 break;
1605 }
1606 }
1607 }
1608 if (!actor) {
1609 for (Actor *candidate : actors) {
1610 if (get_id(candidate) == entry.actor_id) {
1611 actor = candidate;
1612 break;
1613 }
1614 }
1615 }
1616 }
1617 if (!actor)
1618 continue;
1619 WarpActor(actor, entry.x, entry.y, true);
1620 actor->get_actorinfo()->vel = ecl::V2(entry.vx, entry.vy);
1621 }
1622
1623 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1624 g_session.resync_cooldown = 0.0;
1625 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1626 g_session.desync_reported = false;
1627 record_checksum_sample();
1628}

1670bool host_ready_to_start() {
1671 if (!g_session.host)
1672 return false;
1673 if (g_session.expected_players <= 1)
1674 return true;
1675 if (g_session.peer_players.size() + g_session.relay_players.size() +
1676 g_session.tcp_relay_players.size() + 1 <
1677 g_session.expected_players)
1678 return false;
1679 for (const auto &entry : g_session.peer_players) {
1680 auto it = g_session.peer_ready.find(entry.first);
1681 if (it == g_session.peer_ready.end() || !it->second)
1682 return false;
1683 }
1684 for (const auto &entry : g_session.relay_players) {
1685 auto it = g_session.relay_ready.find(entry.first);
1686 if (it == g_session.relay_ready.end() || !it->second)
1687 return false;
1688 }
1689 for (const auto &entry : g_session.tcp_relay_players) {
1690 auto it = g_session.tcp_relay_ready.find(entry.first);
1691 if (it == g_session.tcp_relay_ready.end() || !it->second)
1692 return false;
1693 }
1694 if (g_session.expected_players > g_session.level_players && g_session.level_players > 0) {
1695 if (g_session.placement_received.size() < g_session.expected_players)
1696 return false;
1697 for (unsigned player = g_session.level_players; player < g_session.expected_players; ++player) {
1698 if (!g_session.placement_received[player])
1699 return false;
1700 }
1701 }
1702 return true;
1703}
