1730
1731void handle_sync_current(const protocol::SyncPacket &sync) {
1732 if (sync.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
1733 debug_log("mp sync skip: epoch=%u local epoch=%u",
1734 sync.epoch, g_session.input_epoch);
1735 return;
1736 }
1737 uint32_t local_tick = input::CurrentTick();
1738 if (sync.tick != local_tick) {
1739 debug_log("mp sync skip: sync tick=%u local tick=%u", sync.tick, local_tick);
1740 return;
1741 }
1742 uint64_t local_checksum = WorldChecksum();
1743 update_checksum_sample_world(local_tick, local_checksum);
1744 g_session.last_world_checksum = local_checksum;
1745 bool checksum_mismatch = (sync.world_checksum != 0 && sync.world_checksum != local_checksum);
1746 if (checksum_mismatch) {
1747 debug_log("mp checksum mismatch: tick=%u local=%llu remote=%llu",
1748 sync.tick,
1749 static_cast<unsigned long long>(local_checksum),
1750 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.world_checksum));
1751 }
1752 uint64_t local_actor_checksum = ActorChecksum();
1753 bool actor_mismatch = (sync.actor_checksum != 0 && sync.actor_checksum != local_actor_checksum);
1754 if (actor_mismatch) {
1755 debug_log("mp actor mismatch: tick=%u local=%llu remote=%llu",
1756 sync.tick,
1757 static_cast<unsigned long long>(local_actor_checksum),
1758 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.actor_checksum));
1759 }
1760 Actor *p0 = player::GetMainActor(0);
1761 Actor *p1 = player::GetMainActor(1);
1762 float p0_x = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
1763 float p0_y = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
1764 float p1_x = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
1765 float p1_y = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
1766
1767 auto diff = [](float a, float b) { return fabs(a - b); };
1768 bool rand_mismatch = sync.random_state != server::RandomState;
1769 bool pos_mismatch = diff(sync.p0_x, p0_x) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1770 diff(sync.p0_y, p0_y) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1771 diff(sync.p1_x, p1_x) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1772 diff(sync.p1_y, p1_y) > kSyncPosEpsilon;
1773 if (pos_mismatch || rand_mismatch || actor_mismatch || checksum_mismatch) {
1774 debug_log("mp desync: tick=%u rand local=%u remote=%u "
1775 "p0(%.2f,%.2f)->(%.2f,%.2f) p1(%.2f,%.2f)->(%.2f,%.2f)",
1776 sync.tick, static_cast<unsigned>(server::RandomState),
1777 static_cast<unsigned>(sync.random_state),
1778 p0_x, p0_y, sync.p0_x, sync.p0_y,
1779 p1_x, p1_y, sync.p1_x, sync.p1_y);
1780 if (!pos_mismatch && rand_mismatch && !checksum_mismatch && !actor_mismatch) {
1781 server::RandomState = sync.random_state;
1782 debug_log("mp rng resynced to %u", static_cast<unsigned>(sync.random_state));
1783 return;
1784 }
1785 }
1786
1787 if (checksum_mismatch || actor_mismatch || pos_mismatch) {
1788 if (!g_session.resync_inflight && g_session.resync_cooldown <= 0.0) {
1789 send_resync_request();
1790 g_session.resync_inflight = true;
1791 g_session.resync_attempts += 1;
1792 g_session.resync_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
1793 }
1794 if (g_session.resync_attempts >= kResyncMaxAttempts && !g_session.desync_reported) {
1795 g_session.desync_reported = true;
1796 client::Msg_ShowText("World desync detected. Please restart.", true, 4.0);
1797 }
1798 } else {
1799 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1800 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1801 }
1802}
1803
1804void handle_sync_sample(const protocol::SyncPacket &sync, const SessionState::ChecksumSample &sample) {
1805 if (sync.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
1806 debug_log("mp sync skip: epoch=%u local epoch=%u",
1807 sync.epoch, g_session.input_epoch);
1808 return;
1809 }
1810 bool checksum_mismatch = false;
1811 if (sample.world_valid && sync.world_checksum != 0)
1812 checksum_mismatch = sync.world_checksum != sample.world_checksum;
1813 bool actor_mismatch = (sync.actor_checksum != 0 && sync.actor_checksum != sample.actor_checksum);
1814 bool rand_mismatch = sync.random_state != sample.random_state;
1815
1816 auto diff = [](float a, float b) { return fabs(a - b); };
1817 bool pos_mismatch = diff(sync.p0_x, sample.p0_x) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1818 diff(sync.p0_y, sample.p0_y) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1819 diff(sync.p1_x, sample.p1_x) > kSyncPosEpsilon ||
1820 diff(sync.p1_y, sample.p1_y) > kSyncPosEpsilon;
1821
1822 if (checksum_mismatch) {
1823 debug_log("mp checksum mismatch: tick=%u local=%llu remote=%llu",
1824 sync.tick,
1825 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sample.world_checksum),
1826 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.world_checksum));
1827 }
1828 if (actor_mismatch) {
1829 debug_log("mp actor mismatch: tick=%u local=%llu remote=%llu",
1830 sync.tick,
1831 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sample.actor_checksum),
1832 static_cast<unsigned long long>(sync.actor_checksum));
1833 }
1834 if (pos_mismatch || rand_mismatch || actor_mismatch || checksum_mismatch) {
1835 debug_log("mp desync (late): tick=%u rand local=%u remote=%u "
1836 "p0(%.2f,%.2f)->(%.2f,%.2f) p1(%.2f,%.2f)->(%.2f,%.2f)",
1837 sync.tick,
1838 static_cast<unsigned>(sample.random_state),
1839 static_cast<unsigned>(sync.random_state),
1840 sample.p0_x, sample.p0_y, sync.p0_x, sync.p0_y,
1841 sample.p1_x, sample.p1_y, sync.p1_x, sync.p1_y);
1842 }
1843
1844 if (checksum_mismatch || actor_mismatch || pos_mismatch || rand_mismatch) {
1845 if (!g_session.resync_inflight && g_session.resync_cooldown <= 0.0) {
1846 send_resync_request();
1847 g_session.resync_inflight = true;
1848 g_session.resync_attempts += 1;
1849 g_session.resync_cooldown = kResyncCooldown;
1850 }
1851 if (g_session.resync_attempts >= kResyncMaxAttempts && !g_session.desync_reported) {
1852 g_session.desync_reported = true;
1853 client::Msg_ShowText("World desync detected. Please restart.", true, 4.0);
1854 }
1855 } else {
1856 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
1857 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
1858 }
1859}
1860
1861void record_checksum_sample() {
1862 uint32_t tick = input::CurrentTick();
1863 g_session.last_checksum_tick = tick;
1864 SessionState::ChecksumSample sample;
1865 sample.tick = tick;
1866 sample.actor_checksum = ActorChecksum();
1867 sample.world_checksum = 0;
1868 sample.world_valid = false;
1869 sample.random_state = server::RandomState;
1870 Actor *p0 = player::GetMainActor(0);
1871 Actor *p1 = player::GetMainActor(1);
1872 sample.p0_x = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
1873 sample.p0_y = p0 ? static_cast<float>(p0->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
1874 sample.p1_x = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[0]) : 0.0f;
1875 sample.p1_y = p1 ? static_cast<float>(p1->get_pos()[1]) : 0.0f;
1876 if (!g_session.checksum_history.empty() && g_session.checksum_history.back().tick == tick) {
1877 bool preserve_world = g_session.checksum_history.back().world_valid;
1878 uint64_t preserved_checksum = g_session.checksum_history.back().world_checksum;
1879 g_session.checksum_history.back() = sample;
1880 if (preserve_world) {
1881 g_session.checksum_history.back().world_valid = true;
1882 g_session.checksum_history.back().world_checksum = preserved_checksum;
1883 }
1884 return;
1885 }
1886 g_session.checksum_history.push_back(sample);
1887 while (g_session.checksum_history.size() > kChecksumHistory)
1888 g_session.checksum_history.pop_front();
1889}
1890
1891bool handle_host_packet(const char *data, size_t len, ENetPeer *peer,
1892 HostSource source, Uint32 relay_client_id) {
1893 ecl::Buffer buf;
1894 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1895 protocol::InputPacket input_msg;
1896 if (protocol::decode_input(buf, input_msg)) {
1897 if (input_msg.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
1898 debug_log("mp drop input: tick=%u epoch=%u local epoch=%u",
1899 input_msg.tick, input_msg.epoch, g_session.input_epoch);
1900 return true;
1901 }
1902 if (input_msg.tick < 20) {
1903 debug_log("mp recv input: tick=%u player=%u mouse=(%.2f,%.2f) rot=%d act=%u",
1904 input_msg.tick, input_msg.player, input_msg.mouse_x, input_msg.mouse_y,
1905 static_cast<int>(input_msg.rotate_steps),
1906 static_cast<unsigned>(input_msg.activate_count));
1907 }
1908 if (input_msg.tick < input::CurrentTick())
1909 return true;
1910 unsigned player_id = 0;
1911 bool found = false;
1912 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
1913 auto it = g_session.relay_players.find(relay_client_id);
1914 if (it != g_session.relay_players.end()) {
1915 player_id = it->second;
1916 found = true;
1917 }
1918 } else if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
1919 auto it = g_session.tcp_relay_players.find(relay_client_id);
1920 if (it != g_session.tcp_relay_players.end()) {
1921 player_id = it->second;
1922 found = true;
1923 }
1924 } else {
1925 auto it = g_session.peer_players.find(peer);
1926 if (it != g_session.peer_players.end()) {
1927 player_id = it->second;
1928 found = true;
1929 }
1930 }
1931 if (!found)
1932 return true;
1933 input::PlayerInput pi;
1934 pi.mouse_force = ecl::V2(input_msg.mouse_x, input_msg.mouse_y);
1935 pi.rotate_steps = input_msg.rotate_steps;
1936 pi.activate_count = input_msg.activate_count;
1937 input::EnqueueInput(input_msg.tick, player_id, pi);
1938 protocol::InputPacket forward = input_msg;
1939 forward.player = static_cast<Uint8>(player_id);
1940 broadcast_input(forward,
1941 source == HostSource::DIRECT ? peer : nullptr,
1942 source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY ? relay_client_id : 0,
1943 source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY ? relay_client_id : 0);
1944 return true;
1945 }
1946
1947 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1948 protocol::ResyncRequest req;
1949 if (protocol::decode_resync_request(buf, req)) {
1950 if (req.epoch == g_session.input_epoch) {
1951 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY)
1952 send_resync_state_to_relay(relay_client_id);
1953 else if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY)
1954 send_resync_state_to_tcp_relay(relay_client_id);
1955 else
1956 send_resync_state(peer);
1957 }
1958 return true;
1959 }
1960
1961 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1962 if (protocol::decode_ready(buf)) {
1963 unsigned player_id = 0;
1964 bool found = false;
1965 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY) {
1966 auto it = g_session.relay_players.find(relay_client_id);
1967 if (it != g_session.relay_players.end()) {
1968 player_id = it->second;
1969 found = true;
1970 }
1971 } else if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY) {
1972 auto it = g_session.tcp_relay_players.find(relay_client_id);
1973 if (it != g_session.tcp_relay_players.end()) {
1974 player_id = it->second;
1975 found = true;
1976 }
1977 } else {
1978 auto it = g_session.peer_players.find(peer);
1979 if (it != g_session.peer_players.end()) {
1980 player_id = it->second;
1981 found = true;
1982 }
1983 }
1984 if (found) {
1985 debug_log("mp host: ready player=%u source=%s",
1986 player_id, host_source_name(source));
1987 if (source == HostSource::UDP_RELAY)
1988 g_session.relay_ready[relay_client_id] = true;
1989 else if (source == HostSource::TCP_RELAY)
1990 g_session.tcp_relay_ready[relay_client_id] = true;
1991 else
1992 g_session.peer_ready[peer] = true;
1993 debug_log("mp host: peer ready");
1994 }
1995 return true;
1996 }
1997
1998 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
1999 protocol::PlacementPacket place;
2000 if (protocol::decode_place(buf, place)) {
2001 if (place.restart_id == g_session.restart_id &&
2002 place.player < g_session.expected_players) {
2003 GridPos pos(static_cast<int>(place.x), static_cast<int>(place.y));
2004 if (placement_required_for_player(place.player) &&
2005 is_valid_placement(pos, place.player)) {
2006 apply_placement(place.player, pos);
2007 if (g_session.placement_received.size() > place.player)
2008 g_session.placement_received[place.player] = true;
2009 broadcast_placement(place);
2010 }
2011 }
2012 return true;
2013 }
2014
2015 return false;
2016}
2017
2018void handle_client_payload(const char *data, size_t len) {
2019 ecl::Buffer buf;
2020 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
2021 protocol::InputPacket input_msg;
2022 if (protocol::decode_input(buf, input_msg)) {
2023 if (input_msg.epoch != g_session.input_epoch) {
2024 debug_log("mp drop input: tick=%u epoch=%u local epoch=%u",
2025 input_msg.tick, input_msg.epoch, g_session.input_epoch);
2026 return;
2027 }
2028 if (input_msg.tick < 20) {
2029 debug_log("mp recv input: tick=%u player=%u mouse=(%.2f,%.2f) rot=%d act=%u",
2030 input_msg.tick, input_msg.player, input_msg.mouse_x, input_msg.mouse_y,
2031 static_cast<int>(input_msg.rotate_steps),
2032 static_cast<unsigned>(input_msg.activate_count));
2033 }
2034 if (input_msg.tick < input::CurrentTick())
2035 return;
2036 input::PlayerInput pi;
2037 pi.mouse_force = ecl::V2(input_msg.mouse_x, input_msg.mouse_y);
2038 pi.rotate_steps = input_msg.rotate_steps;
2039 pi.activate_count = input_msg.activate_count;
2040 input::EnqueueInput(input_msg.tick, input_msg.player, pi);
2041 return;
2042 }
2043
2044 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
2045 Uint8 player_id = 0;
2046 Uint8 expected_players = 0;
2047 Uint32 seed = 0;
2048 if (protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected_players, seed)) {
2049 g_session.local_player = player_id;
2050 g_session.local_player_known = true;
2051 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
2052 g_session.seed = seed;
2053 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected_players);
2054 debug_log("mp client: welcome player=%u expected=%u seed=%u",
2055 player_id, expected_players, seed);
2056 if (debug_enabled())
2057 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s", transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
2058 if (g_session.start_requested && !g_session.ready_sent) {
2059 send_ready_to_host();
2060 g_session.ready_sent = true;
2061 g_session.ready_timer = 0.0;
2062 }
2063 return;
2064 }
2065
2066 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
2067 protocol::SyncPacket sync;
2068 if (protocol::decode_sync(buf, sync)) {
2069 uint32_t local_tick = input::CurrentTick();
2070 if (local_tick < sync.tick) {
2071 g_session.pending_sync = sync;
2072 g_session.has_pending_sync = true;
2073 } else if (local_tick == sync.tick) {
2074 handle_sync_current(sync);
2075 } else {
2076 SessionState::ChecksumSample sample;
2077 if (lookup_checksum_sample(sync.tick, sample)) {
2078 handle_sync_sample(sync, sample);
2079 } else {
2080 debug_log("mp sync skip: sync tick=%u local tick=%u (no history)",
2081 sync.tick, local_tick);
2082 }
2083 }
2084 return;
2085 }
2086
2087 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
2088 protocol::ResyncState state;
2089 if (protocol::decode_resync_state(buf, state)) {
2090 apply_resync_state(state);
2091 return;
2092 }
2093
2094 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
2095 Uint32 epoch = 0;
2096 if (protocol::decode_start(buf, epoch)) {
2097 g_session.input_epoch = epoch;
2098 configure_input_session(g_session.expected_players);
2099 g_session.start_allowed = true;
2100 debug_log("mp client: start allowed");
2101 return;
2102 }
2103
2104 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
2105 protocol::RestartPacket restart;
2106 if (protocol::decode_restart(buf, restart)) {
2107 if (restart.restart_id > g_session.last_restart_id) {
2108 g_session.last_restart_id = restart.restart_id;
2109 g_session.restart_id = restart.restart_id;
2110 if (restart.level_restart)
2111 server::RestartLevelFromNetwork();
2112 else
2113 server::Msg_RestartGameFromNetwork();
2114 }
2115 return;
2116 }
2117
2118 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), len);
2119 protocol::PlacementPacket place;
2120 if (protocol::decode_place(buf, place)) {
2121 if (place.restart_id == g_session.restart_id &&
2122 place.player < g_session.expected_players) {
2123 GridPos pos(static_cast<int>(place.x), static_cast<int>(place.y));
2124 apply_placement(place.player, pos);
2125 }
2126 return;
2127 }
2128}
2129
2130void process_network_events() {
2131 if (!g_session.active)
2132 return;
2133
2134 // Direct ENet sessions (host or client). TCP-relay-only clients don't have a host_handle.
2135 if (g_session.host_handle != nullptr) {
2136 ENetEvent event;
2137 while (enet_host_service(g_session.host_handle, &event, 0) > 0) {
2138 switch (event.type) {
2139 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT:
2140 if (g_session.host) {
2141 if (g_session.next_player_id >= g_session.expected_players) {
2142 enet_peer_disconnect(event.peer, 0);
2143 break;
2144 }
2145 unsigned player_id = g_session.next_player_id++;
2146 g_session.peer_players[event.peer] = player_id;
2147 g_session.peer_ready[event.peer] = false;
2148 event.peer->data = reinterpret_cast<void *>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(player_id));
2149 debug_log("mp host: peer connected -> player %u", player_id);
2150 ecl::Buffer buf;
2151 protocol::encode_welcome(buf, static_cast<Uint8>(player_id),
2152 static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.expected_players),
2153 g_session.seed);
2154 ENetPacket *packet =
2155 enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(), ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
2156 enet_peer_send(event.peer, 0, packet);
2157 send_existing_placements_to_peer(event.peer);
2158 }
2159 break;
2160 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE: {
2161 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(event.packet->data);
2162 if (g_session.host) {
2163 handle_host_packet(data, event.packet->dataLength, event.peer,
2164 HostSource::DIRECT, 0);
2165 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
2166 break;
2167 }
2168
2169 handle_client_payload(data, event.packet->dataLength);
2170 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
2171 break;
2172 }
2173 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT:
2174 if (g_session.host) {
2175 g_session.peer_players.erase(event.peer);
2176 g_session.peer_ready.erase(event.peer);
2177 if (g_session.active) {
2178 if (!client::AbortGameP())
2179 client::Msg_ShowText("Player disconnected. Ending session.", true, 3.0);
2180 client::Msg_Command("abort");
2181 Shutdown();
2182 return;
2183 }
2184 } else {
2185 if (!client::AbortGameP())
2186 client::Msg_ShowText("Disconnected from host.", true, 3.0);
2187 client::Msg_Command("abort");
2188 Shutdown();
2189 return;
2190 }
2191 break;
2192 default:
2193 break;
2194 }
2195 }
2196 }
2197
2198 if (g_session.host && g_session.relay_handle) {
2199 ENetEvent event;
2200 while (enet_host_service(g_session.relay_handle, &event, 0) > 0) {
2201 switch (event.type) {
2202 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE: {
2203 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(event.packet->data);
2204 RelayMessageType type = RELAY_ERROR;
2205 Uint32 session_id = 0;
2206 Uint32 client_id = 0;
2207 const char *payload = nullptr;
2208 size_t payload_len = 0;
2209 if (!decode_relay_header(data, event.packet->dataLength, type,
2210 session_id, client_id, payload, payload_len)) {
2211 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
2212 break;
2213 }
2214 if (session_id != g_session.session_id) {
2215 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
2216 break;
2217 }
2218 if (type == RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT) {
2219 if (g_session.next_player_id >= g_session.expected_players) {
2220 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
2221 break;
2222 }
2223 unsigned player_id = g_session.next_player_id++;
2224 g_session.relay_players[client_id] = player_id;
2225 g_session.relay_ready[client_id] = false;
2226 debug_log("mp host: relay client -> player %u", player_id);
2227 ecl::Buffer buf;
2228 protocol::encode_welcome(buf, static_cast<Uint8>(player_id),
2229 static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.expected_players),
2230 g_session.seed);
2231 send_relay_payload(client_id, buf);
2232 send_existing_placements_to_relay(client_id);
2233 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
2234 break;
2235 }
2236 if (type == RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT) {
2237 g_session.relay_players.erase(client_id);
2238 g_session.relay_ready.erase(client_id);
2239 if (g_session.active) {
2240 if (!client::AbortGameP())
2241 client::Msg_ShowText("Player disconnected. Ending session.", true, 3.0);
2242 client::Msg_Command("abort");
2243 Shutdown();
2244 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
2245 return;
2246 }
2247 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
2248 break;
2249 }
2250 if (type == RELAY_DATA) {
2251 handle_host_packet(payload, payload_len, nullptr, HostSource::UDP_RELAY, client_id);
2252 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
2253 break;
2254 }
2255 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
2256 break;
2257 }
2258 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT:
2259 if (g_session.relay_peer == event.peer) {
2260 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
2261 if (!g_session.relay_players.empty()) {
2262 if (!client::AbortGameP())
2263 client::Msg_ShowText("Relay disconnected. Ending session.", true, 3.0);
2264 client::Msg_Command("abort");
2265 Shutdown();
2266 return;
2267 }
2268 }
2269 break;
2270 default:
2271 break;
2272 }
2273 }
2274 }
2275
2276 if (tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket)) {
2277 if (!tcp_pump_recv(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, g_session.tcp_relay_rx)) {
2278 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
2279 if (g_session.host) {
2280 if (!g_session.tcp_relay_players.empty()) {
2281 if (!client::AbortGameP())
2282 client::Msg_ShowText("TCP relay disconnected. Ending session.", true, 3.0);
2283 client::Msg_Command("abort");
2284 Shutdown();
2285 return;
2286 }
2287 } else if (g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY) {
2288 if (!client::AbortGameP())
2289 client::Msg_ShowText("Disconnected from TCP relay.", true, 3.0);
2290 client::Msg_Command("abort");
2291 Shutdown();
2292 return;
2293 }
2294 }
2295
2296 std::vector<uint8_t> frame;
2297 while (tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket) &&
2298 tcp_try_extract_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_rx, g_session.tcp_relay_frame_len, frame)) {
2299 if (g_session.host) {
2300 RelayMessageType type = RELAY_ERROR;
2301 Uint32 session_id = 0;
2302 Uint32 client_id = 0;
2303 const char *payload = nullptr;
2304 size_t payload_len = 0;
2305 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(frame.data());
2306 if (!decode_relay_header(data, frame.size(), type, session_id, client_id,
2307 payload, payload_len)) {
2308 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
2309 break;
2310 }
2311 if (session_id != g_session.session_id)
2312 continue;
2313 if (type == RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT) {
2314 if (g_session.next_player_id >= g_session.expected_players)
2315 continue;
2316 unsigned player_id = g_session.next_player_id++;
2317 g_session.tcp_relay_players[client_id] = player_id;
2318 g_session.tcp_relay_ready[client_id] = false;
2319 debug_log("mp host: tcp relay client -> player %u", player_id);
2320 ecl::Buffer buf;
2321 protocol::encode_welcome(buf, static_cast<Uint8>(player_id),
2322 static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.expected_players),
2323 g_session.seed);
2324 send_tcp_relay_payload(client_id, buf);
2325 send_existing_placements_to_tcp_relay(client_id);
2326 continue;
2327 }
2328 if (type == RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT) {
2329 g_session.tcp_relay_players.erase(client_id);
2330 g_session.tcp_relay_ready.erase(client_id);
2331 if (g_session.active) {
2332 if (!client::AbortGameP())
2333 client::Msg_ShowText("Player disconnected. Ending session.", true, 3.0);
2334 client::Msg_Command("abort");
2335 Shutdown();
2336 return;
2337 }
2338 continue;
2339 }
2340 if (type == RELAY_DATA) {
2341 handle_host_packet(payload, payload_len, nullptr, HostSource::TCP_RELAY, client_id);
2342 continue;
2343 }
2344 } else if (g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY) {
2345 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(frame.data());
2346 handle_client_payload(data, frame.size());
2347 }
2348 }
2349 }
2350}
2351
2352void send_local_inputs() {
2353 if (!g_session.active || !g_session.local_player_known)
2354 return;
2355 uint32_t current_tick = input::CurrentTick();
2356 uint32_t target_tick = current_tick + kInputDelay;
2357 if (g_session.input_clock_tick > current_tick) {
2358 uint32_t extra = g_session.input_clock_tick - current_tick;
2359 if (extra > kMaxInputLead)
2360 extra = kMaxInputLead;
2361 target_tick += extra;
2362 }
2363 input::PlayerInput pending = input::DrainLocalPending(g_session.local_player);
2364 bool applied = false;
2365 bool sent_packets = false;
2366
2367 while (g_session.next_local_tick <= target_tick) {
2368 input::PlayerInput send = applied ? input::PlayerInput() : pending;
2369 if (!send.empty()) {
2370 float fx = static_cast<float>(send.mouse_force[0]);
2371 float fy = static_cast<float>(send.mouse_force[1]);
2372 send.mouse_force = ecl::V2(fx, fy);
2373 }
2374 protocol::InputPacket pkt;
2375 pkt.epoch = g_session.input_epoch;
2376 pkt.tick = g_session.next_local_tick;
2377 pkt.player = static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.local_player);
2378 pkt.mouse_x = static_cast<float>(send.mouse_force[0]);
2379 pkt.mouse_y = static_cast<float>(send.mouse_force[1]);
2380 pkt.rotate_steps = static_cast<int16_t>(send.rotate_steps);
2381 pkt.activate_count = static_cast<Uint8>(send.activate_count);
2382
2383 input::EnqueueInput(pkt.tick, g_session.local_player, send);
2384 g_session.local_history[pkt.tick] = send;
2385 applied = true;
2386 ++g_session.next_local_tick;
2387 }
2388
2389 if (g_session.host) {
2390 if (!has_remote_peers())
2391 return;
2392 } else if (!g_session.server_peer) {
2393 if (!(g_session.active_transport == TransportKind::TCP_RELAY &&
2394 tcp_socket_valid(g_session.tcp_relay_socket))) {
2395 return;
2396 }
2397 }
2398
2399 uint32_t send_tick = g_session.next_send_tick;
2400 if (send_tick < current_tick)
2401 send_tick = current_tick;
2402 while (send_tick < g_session.next_local_tick) {
2403 protocol::InputPacket pkt;
2404 pkt.epoch = g_session.input_epoch;
2405 pkt.tick = send_tick;
2406 pkt.player = static_cast<Uint8>(g_session.local_player);
2407 auto it = g_session.local_history.find(pkt.tick);
2408 if (it != g_session.local_history.end()) {
2409 const input::PlayerInput &queued = it->second;
2410 pkt.mouse_x = static_cast<float>(queued.mouse_force[0]);
2411 pkt.mouse_y = static_cast<float>(queued.mouse_force[1]);
2412 pkt.rotate_steps = static_cast<int16_t>(queued.rotate_steps);
2413 pkt.activate_count = static_cast<Uint8>(queued.activate_count);
2414 g_session.local_history.erase(it);
2415 } else {
2416 pkt.mouse_x = 0.0f;
2417 pkt.mouse_y = 0.0f;
2418 pkt.rotate_steps = 0;
2419 pkt.activate_count = 0;
2420 }
2421 if (pkt.tick < 20) {
2422 debug_log("mp send input: tick=%u player=%u mouse=(%.2f,%.2f) rot=%d act=%u",
2423 pkt.tick, pkt.player, pkt.mouse_x, pkt.mouse_y,
2424 static_cast<int>(pkt.rotate_steps),
2425 static_cast<unsigned>(pkt.activate_count));
2426 }
2427 if (g_session.host)
2428 broadcast_input(pkt, nullptr, 0, 0);
2429 else {
2430 ecl::Buffer payload;
2431 protocol::encode_input(payload, pkt);
2432 client_send_payload(payload);
2433 }
2434 sent_packets = true;
2435 ++send_tick;
2436 }
2437 g_session.next_send_tick = send_tick;
2438
2439 if (sent_packets && g_session.host_handle)
2440 enet_host_flush(g_session.host_handle);
2441}

2516 for (unsigned player = 0; player < g_session.expected_players; ++player) {

2523
2524void PrimeInputQueueForNewLevel() {
2525 if (!g_session.active)
2526 return;
2527 configure_input_session(g_session.expected_players);
2528 g_session.desync_reported = false;
2529 g_session.start_requested = false;
2530 g_session.start_allowed = false;
2531 g_session.ready_sent = false;
2532 g_session.ready_timer = 0.0;
2533 g_session.has_pending_sync = false;
2534 g_session.last_world_checksum = 0;
2535 g_session.checksum_history.clear();
2536 g_session.last_checksum_tick = UINT32_MAX;
2537 g_session.resync_inflight = false;
2538 g_session.resync_cooldown = 0.0;
2539 g_session.resync_attempts = 0;
2540 g_session.ready_timer = 0.0;
2541 g_session.level_players = 0;
2542 g_session.placement_received.clear();
2543 if (g_session.host) {
2544 for (auto &entry : g_session.peer_ready)
2545 entry.second = false;
2546 for (auto &entry : g_session.relay_ready)
2547 entry.second = false;
2548 }
2549}

2551void LobbyStart() {
2552 if (g_lobby.active)
2553 return;
2554 g_lobby.active = true;
2555 g_lobby.local_id = make_id();
2556 g_lobby.local_name = resolve_local_name();
2557 g_lobby.time = 0.0;
2558 g_lobby.announce_timer = 0.0;
2559 g_lobby.peers.clear();
2560 g_lobby.has_pending_start = false;
2561 g_lobby.pending_host_ip.clear();
2562 g_lobby.last_session_id = 0;
2563
2564 g_lobby.socket = enet_socket_create_compat(ENET_SOCKET_TYPE_DATAGRAM);
2565 if (g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
2566 debug_log("mp lobby: socket create failed");
2567 g_lobby.active = false;
2568 return;
2569 }
2570 if (!bind_lobby_socket(g_lobby.socket, kLobbyPort)) {
2571 debug_log("mp lobby: bind failed port=%u", static_cast<unsigned>(kLobbyPort));
2572 enet_socket_destroy(g_lobby.socket);
2573 g_lobby.socket = ENET_SOCKET_NULL;
2574 g_lobby.active = false;
2575 return;
2576 }
2577 debug_log("mp lobby: started port=%u id=%s name=%s",
2578 static_cast<unsigned>(kLobbyPort),
2579 g_lobby.local_id.c_str(),
2580 g_lobby.local_name.c_str());
2581 send_lobby_announce();
2582}
2583
2584void LobbyStop() {
2585 if (!g_lobby.active)
2586 return;
2587 if (g_lobby.socket != ENET_SOCKET_NULL) {
2588 enet_socket_destroy(g_lobby.socket);
2589 g_lobby.socket = ENET_SOCKET_NULL;
2590 }
2591 g_lobby.active = false;
2592 g_lobby.peers.clear();
2593}
2594
2595void LobbyTick(double dtime) {
2596 if (!g_lobby.active)
2597 return;
2598 g_lobby.time += dtime;
2599 g_lobby.announce_timer += dtime;
2600 if (g_lobby.announce_timer >= kAnnounceInterval) {
2601 g_lobby.announce_timer = 0.0;
2602 send_lobby_announce();
2603 }
2604 poll_lobby_socket();
2605 cleanup_lobby_peers();
2606}

2608std::vector<LobbyPeer> LobbyPeers() {

2616 self.address = "localhost";
2617 self.is_self = true;
2618 result.push_back(self);

2648protocol::LobbyStart BuildStartMessage(const std::string &level_id, unsigned expected_players,
2649 unsigned filter_min_players) {
2650 protocol::LobbyStart start;
2651 std::random_device rd;
2652 Uint32 seed = static_cast<Uint32>(rd() ^ SDL_GetTicks());
2653 Uint32 session_id = static_cast<Uint32>((rd() << 16) ^ SDL_GetTicks());
2654 start.session_id = session_id;
2655 start.level_id = level_id;
2656 start.seed = seed;
2657 start.expected_players = static_cast<Uint8>(expected_players);
2658 start.host_port = kGamePort;
2659 start.host_id = g_lobby.local_id;
2660 if (filter_min_players < 1)
2661 filter_min_players = 1;
2662 if (filter_min_players > expected_players)
2663 filter_min_players = expected_players;
2664 start.filter_optimized = static_cast<Uint8>(filter_min_players);
2665 return start;
2666}

2668void LobbyBroadcastStart(const protocol::LobbyStart &start) {
2669 if (!g_lobby.active || g_lobby.socket == ENET_SOCKET_NULL)
2670 return;
2671 ecl::Buffer buf;
2672 protocol::encode_lobby_start(buf, start);
2673 ENetAddress addr;
2674 addr.host = ENET_HOST_BROADCAST;
2675 addr.port = kLobbyPort;
2676 ENetBuffer eb;
2677 eb.data = const_cast<char *>(buf.data());
2678 eb.dataLength = buf.size();
2679 enet_socket_send(g_lobby.socket, &addr, &eb, 1);
2680}

2694
2695bool InternetCreateRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
2696 const protocol::LobbyStart &start, std::string &error) {
2697 ensure_lobby_identity();
2698 ecl::Buffer request;
2699 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_CREATE)
2700 << room_code << Uint32(start.session_id) << Uint32(start.seed)
2701 << Uint8(start.expected_players) << Uint16(start.host_port)
2702 << Uint8(start.filter_optimized) << start.level_id << start.host_id;
2703
2704 ecl::Buffer response;
2705 if (!internet_exchange(server, request, response, error))
2706 return false;
2707
2708 Uint32 magic = 0;
2709 Uint8 version = 0;
2710 Uint8 type = 0;
2711 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
2712 return false;
2713 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
2714 return false;
2715 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
2716 std::string msg;
2717 response >> msg;
2718 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
2719 return false;
2720 }
2721 if (type != INET_CREATE_OK)
2722 return false;
2723 std::string host_ip;
2724 std::string server_room;
2725 if (!(response >> server_room >> host_ip))
2726 return false;
2727 (void)host_ip;
2728 return true;
2729}
2730
2731bool InternetJoinRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
2732 protocol::LobbyStart &start, std::string &host_ip,
2733 unsigned &player_count, std::string &error) {
2734 ensure_lobby_identity();
2735 player_count = 0;
2736 ecl::Buffer request;
2737 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_JOIN)
2738 << room_code << g_lobby.local_id;
2739
2740 ecl::Buffer response;
2741 if (!internet_exchange(server, request, response, error))
2742 return false;
2743
2744 Uint32 magic = 0;
2745 Uint8 version = 0;
2746 Uint8 type = 0;
2747 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
2748 return false;
2749 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
2750 return false;
2751 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
2752 std::string msg;
2753 response >> msg;
2754 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
2755 return false;
2756 }
2757 if (type != INET_JOIN_OK)
2758 return false;
2759 if (!(response >> start.session_id >> start.level_id >> start.seed
2760 >> start.expected_players >> start.host_port >> start.host_id
2761 >> start.filter_optimized >> host_ip))
2762 return false;
2763 if (response.get_rpos() < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(response.size())) {
2764 Uint8 count = 0;
2765 if (response >> count)
2766 player_count = count;
2767 }
2768 return true;
2769}

2802bool InternetPollRoom(const std::string &server, const std::string &room_code,
2803 protocol::LobbyStart &start, std::string &host_ip,
2804 bool &started, unsigned &player_count, std::string &error) {
2805 ensure_lobby_identity();
2806 started = false;
2807 player_count = 0;
2808 ecl::Buffer request;
2809 request << Uint32(kInternetMagic) << Uint8(kInternetVersion) << Uint8(INET_POLL)
2810 << room_code;
2811
2812 ecl::Buffer response;
2813 if (!internet_exchange(server, request, response, error))
2814 return false;
2815
2816 Uint32 magic = 0;
2817 Uint8 version = 0;
2818 Uint8 type = 0;
2819 if (!(response >> magic >> version >> type))
2820 return false;
2821 if (magic != kInternetMagic || version != kInternetVersion)
2822 return false;
2823 if (type == INET_ERROR) {
2824 std::string msg;
2825 response >> msg;
2826 error = msg.empty() ? "Server error." : msg;
2827 return false;
2828 }
2829 if (type != INET_POLL_OK)
2830 return false;
2831 Uint8 started_flag = 0;
2832 Uint8 count = 0;
2833 if (!(response >> started_flag >> count))
2834 return false;
2835 started = (started_flag != 0);
2836 player_count = count;
2837 if (!started)
2838 return true;
2839 if (!(response >> start.session_id >> start.level_id >> start.seed
2840 >> start.expected_players >> start.host_port >> start.host_id
2841 >> start.filter_optimized >> host_ip))
2842 return false;
2843 return true;
2844}

2881bool StartHostSession(const protocol::LobbyStart &start) {
2882 if (g_session.active)
2883 return false;
2884 if (debug_enabled())
2885 debug_log("mp debug enabled");
2886 unsigned expected_players = std::min<unsigned>(start.expected_players, input::kMaxPlayers);
2887 if (expected_players < 1)
2888 return false;
2889 g_session.active = true;
2890 g_session.host = true;
2891 g_session.local_player_known = true;
2892 g_session.local_player = 0;
2893 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
2894 g_session.active_transport = TransportKind::NONE;
2895 g_session.session_id = start.session_id;
2896 g_session.seed = start.seed;
2897 g_session.input_epoch = 0;
2898 g_session.restart_id = 0;
2899 g_session.last_restart_id = 0;
2900 g_session.next_player_id = 1;
2901 g_session.next_local_tick = kInputDelay;
2902 g_session.next_send_tick = 0;
2903 g_session.local_history.clear();
2904 g_session.sync_timer = 0.0;
2905 g_session.desync_reported = false;
2906 g_session.start_requested = false;
2907 g_session.start_allowed = false;
2908 g_session.ready_sent = false;
2909 g_session.ready_timer = 0.0;
2910 g_session.checksum_history.clear();
2911 g_session.last_checksum_tick = UINT32_MAX;
2912 g_session.peer_players.clear();
2913 g_session.peer_ready.clear();
2914 g_session.relay_players.clear();
2915 g_session.relay_ready.clear();
2916 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
2917 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
2918 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
2919 g_session.tcp_relay_rx.clear();
2920 g_session.tcp_relay_frame_len = 0;
2921 g_session.tcp_relay_players.clear();
2922 g_session.tcp_relay_ready.clear();
2923
2924 enigma::Randomize(start.seed, true);
2925 configure_input_session(expected_players);
2926
2927 ENetAddress address;
2928 address.host = ENET_HOST_ANY;
2929 address.port = start.host_port;
2930 g_session.host_handle = enet_host_create(&address, expected_players - 1,
2931#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
2932 2 /* channels */,
2933#endif
2934 0, 0);
2935 if (g_session.host_handle == nullptr) {
2936 Shutdown();
2937 return false;
2938 }
2939 // Do not tweak ENet-managed sockets. ENet already configures non-blocking
2940 // mode and buffering; overriding this can break connect/handshake on some
2941 // platform builds.
2942 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerEnableUdpRelay") && !g_relay_server.empty()) {
2943 if (debug_enabled())
2944 debug_log("mp host: relay server=%s", g_relay_server.c_str());
2945 std::string relay_host;
2946 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
2947 if (parse_host_port(g_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port)) {
2948 if (g_session.relay_handle)
2949 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
2950 g_session.relay_handle = enet_host_create(nullptr, 1,
2951#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
2952 2 /* channels */,
2953#endif
2954 0, 0);
2955 if (g_session.relay_handle) {
2956 // Do not tweak ENet-managed sockets; see note above.
2957 ENetAddress relay_addr;
2958 enet_address_set_host(&relay_addr, relay_host.c_str());
2959 relay_addr.port = relay_port;
2960 g_session.relay_peer = enet_host_connect(g_session.relay_handle, &relay_addr, 2
2961#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
2962 ,
2963 0 /* data */
2964#endif
2965 );
2966 if (g_session.relay_peer) {
2967 ENetEvent event;
2968 if (enet_host_service(g_session.relay_handle, &event, 3000) > 0 &&
2969 event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT) {
2970 g_session.relay_peer = event.peer;
2971 ecl::Buffer buf;
2972 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_HELLO_HOST, g_session.session_id, 0);
2973 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(),
2974 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
2975 enet_peer_send(g_session.relay_peer, 0, packet);
2976 enet_host_flush(g_session.relay_handle);
2977 debug_log("mp host: connected to relay %s:%u",
2978 relay_host.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
2979 } else {
2980 debug_log("mp host: relay connect timeout %s:%u",
2981 relay_host.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
2982 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
2983 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
2984 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
2985 }
2986 } else {
2987 debug_log("mp host: relay connect failed %s:%u",
2988 relay_host.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
2989 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
2990 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
2991 }
2992 }
2993 }
2994 }
2995
2996 if (options::GetBool("MultiplayerEnableTcpRelay") && !g_tcp_relay_server.empty()) {
2997 if (debug_enabled())
2998 debug_log("mp host: tcp relay server=%s", g_tcp_relay_server.c_str());
2999 std::string relay_host;
3000 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
3001 if (parse_host_port(g_tcp_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port)) {
3002 TcpSocket sock;
3003 if (tcp_connect_timeout(relay_host, relay_port, 3000, sock)) {
3004 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = sock;
3005 ecl::Buffer buf;
3006 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_HELLO_HOST, g_session.session_id, 0);
3007 if (tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, buf.data(), buf.size())) {
3008 debug_log("mp host: connected to tcp relay %s:%u",
3009 relay_host.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
3010 } else {
3011 debug_log("mp host: tcp relay hello failed %s:%u",
3012 relay_host.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
3013 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
3014 }
3015 } else {
3016 debug_log("mp host: tcp relay connect failed %s:%u",
3017 relay_host.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
3018 }
3019 }
3020 }
3021 return true;
3022}
3023
3024bool StartClientSession(const protocol::LobbyStart &start, const std::string &host_ip) {
3025 if (g_session.active)
3026 return false;
3027 if (debug_enabled())
3028 debug_log("mp debug enabled");
3029 unsigned expected_players = std::min<unsigned>(start.expected_players, input::kMaxPlayers);
3030 if (expected_players < 1)
3031 return false;
3032 g_session.active = true;
3033 g_session.host = false;
3034 g_session.local_player_known = false;
3035 g_session.local_player = 1;
3036 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
3037 g_session.active_transport = TransportKind::NONE;
3038 g_session.session_id = start.session_id;
3039 g_session.seed = start.seed;
3040 g_session.input_epoch = 0;
3041 g_session.restart_id = 0;
3042 g_session.last_restart_id = 0;
3043 g_session.next_local_tick = kInputDelay;
3044 g_session.next_send_tick = 0;
3045 g_session.local_history.clear();
3046 g_session.sync_timer = 0.0;
3047 g_session.desync_reported = false;
3048 g_session.start_requested = false;
3049 g_session.start_allowed = false;
3050 g_session.ready_sent = false;
3051 g_session.checksum_history.clear();
3052 g_session.last_checksum_tick = UINT32_MAX;
3053 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
3054 g_session.tcp_relay_rx.clear();
3055 g_session.tcp_relay_frame_len = 0;
3056
3057 enigma::Randomize(start.seed, true);
3058 configure_input_session(expected_players);
3059 const bool enable_direct = options::GetBool("MultiplayerEnableDirect");
3060 const bool enable_udp_relay = options::GetBool("MultiplayerEnableUdpRelay");
3061 const bool enable_tcp_relay = options::GetBool("MultiplayerEnableTcpRelay");
3062
3063 auto connect_and_wait = [&](const std::string &target_host, Uint16 target_port,
3064 bool relay_connect, Uint32 connect_timeout_ms,
3065 Uint32 welcome_timeout_ms) -> bool {
3066 if (debug_enabled())
3067 debug_log("mp client: connect %s:%u relay=%d",
3068 target_host.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned>(target_port),
3069 relay_connect ? 1 : 0);
3070 if (g_session.host_handle) {
3071 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
3072 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
3073 }
3074 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
3075 g_session.host_handle = enet_host_create(nullptr, 1,
3076#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
3077 2 /* channels */,
3078#endif
3079 0, 0);
3080 if (g_session.host_handle == nullptr)
3081 return false;
3082 // Do not tweak ENet-managed sockets; see note above.
3083
3084 ENetAddress addr;
3085 enet_address_set_host(&addr, target_host.c_str());
3086 addr.port = target_port;
3087 g_session.server_peer = enet_host_connect(g_session.host_handle, &addr, 2
3088#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
3089 ,
3090 0 /* data */
3091#endif
3092 );
3093 if (g_session.server_peer == nullptr)
3094 return false;
3095
3096 ENetEvent event;
3097 if (!(enet_host_service(g_session.host_handle, &event, connect_timeout_ms) > 0 &&
3098 event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT)) {
3099 if (debug_enabled())
3100 debug_log("mp client: connect failed %s:%u", target_host.c_str(),
3101 static_cast<unsigned>(target_port));
3102 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
3103 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
3104 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
3105 return false;
3106 }
3107 g_session.server_peer = event.peer;
3108 if (relay_connect) {
3109 ecl::Buffer buf;
3110 encode_relay_header(buf, RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT, start.session_id, 0);
3111 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(buf.data(), buf.size(),
3112 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
3113 enet_peer_send(g_session.server_peer, 0, packet);
3114 enet_host_flush(g_session.host_handle);
3115 }
3116
3117 Uint32 start_wait = SDL_GetTicks();
3118 while (SDL_GetTicks() - start_wait < welcome_timeout_ms) {
3119 int res = enet_host_service(g_session.host_handle, &event, 100);
3120 if (res <= 0)
3121 continue;
3122 if (event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE) {
3123 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(event.packet->data);
3124 ecl::Buffer buf;
3125 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), event.packet->dataLength);
3126 Uint8 player_id = 0;
3127 Uint8 expected_players = 0;
3128 Uint32 seed = 0;
3129 if (protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected_players, seed)) {
3130 if (debug_enabled())
3131 debug_log("mp client: welcome player=%u expected=%u seed=%u",
3132 static_cast<unsigned>(player_id),
3133 static_cast<unsigned>(expected_players),
3134 static_cast<unsigned>(seed));
3135 g_session.local_player = player_id;
3136 g_session.local_player_known = true;
3137 g_session.expected_players = expected_players;
3138 g_session.seed = seed;
3139 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected_players);
3140 g_session.active_transport = relay_connect ? TransportKind::UDP_RELAY
3141 : TransportKind::DIRECT;
3142 if (debug_enabled())
3143 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s", transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
3144 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
3145 return true;
3146 }
3147 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
3148 } else if (event.type == ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT) {
3149 break;
3150 }
3151 }
3152 if (debug_enabled())
3153 debug_log("mp client: welcome timeout %s:%u", target_host.c_str(),
3154 static_cast<unsigned>(target_port));
3155 if (g_session.server_peer) {
3156 enet_peer_reset(g_session.server_peer);
3157 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
3158 }
3159 if (g_session.host_handle) {
3160 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
3161 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
3162 }
3163 return false;
3164 };
3165
3166 // The host may take several seconds to load the level before it services ENet,
3167 // especially on slower machines/VMs. Use a generous timeout for the initial
3168 // connect/welcome handshake to avoid spurious join failures.
3169 constexpr Uint32 kJoinTimeoutMs = 15000;
3170
3171 if (enable_direct && !force_relay_enabled()) {
3172 // Keep the actual connect timeout short, but allow a longer welcome window
3173 // in case the host is still loading/binding when the client attempts to join.
3174 if (connect_and_wait(host_ip, start.host_port, false, 3000, kJoinTimeoutMs))
3175 return true;
3176 } else if (debug_enabled()) {
3177 if (!enable_direct)
3178 debug_log("mp client: direct connect disabled");
3179 if (force_relay_enabled())
3180 debug_log("mp client: force relay enabled");
3181 }
3182
3183 if (enable_udp_relay && !g_relay_server.empty()) {
3184 if (debug_enabled())
3185 debug_log("mp client: relay server=%s", g_relay_server.c_str());
3186 std::string relay_host;
3187 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
3188 if (parse_host_port(g_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port)) {
3189 if (connect_and_wait(relay_host, relay_port, true, 2000, kJoinTimeoutMs))
3190 return true;
3191 }
3192 } else if (debug_enabled() && !enable_udp_relay) {
3193 debug_log("mp client: udp relay disabled");
3194 }
3195
3196 if (enable_tcp_relay && !g_tcp_relay_server.empty()) {
3197 // Ensure stale ENet state from previous attempts (direct/udp-relay) does
3198 // not interfere with TCP relay operation (client_send_payload prefers
3199 // server_peer if set).
3200 if (g_session.host_handle) {
3201 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
3202 g_session.host_handle = nullptr;
3203 }
3204 g_session.server_peer = nullptr;
3205
3206 if (debug_enabled())
3207 debug_log("mp client: tcp relay server=%s", g_tcp_relay_server.c_str());
3208 std::string relay_host;
3209 Uint16 relay_port = 0;
3210 if (parse_host_port(g_tcp_relay_server, relay_host, relay_port)) {
3211 TcpSocket sock;
3212 if (tcp_connect_timeout(relay_host, relay_port, 3000, sock)) {
3213 g_session.tcp_relay_socket = sock;
3214 ecl::Buffer hello;
3215 encode_relay_header(hello, RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT, start.session_id, 0);
3216 if (!tcp_send_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, hello.data(), hello.size())) {
3217 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
3218 } else {
3219 Uint32 start_wait = SDL_GetTicks();
3220 std::vector<uint8_t> frame;
3221 while (SDL_GetTicks() - start_wait < kJoinTimeoutMs) {
3222 fd_set rfds;
3223 FD_ZERO(&rfds);
3224 FD_SET(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, &rfds);
3225 timeval tv;
3226 tv.tv_sec = 0;
3227 tv.tv_usec = 100 * 1000;
3228#ifdef WIN32
3229 int sel = ::select(0, &rfds, nullptr, nullptr, &tv);
3230#else
3231 int sel = ::select(g_session.tcp_relay_socket + 1, &rfds, nullptr, nullptr, &tv);
3232#endif
3233 if (sel <= 0)
3234 continue;
3235 if (!tcp_pump_recv(g_session.tcp_relay_socket, g_session.tcp_relay_rx)) {
3236 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
3237 break;
3238 }
3239 while (tcp_try_extract_frame(g_session.tcp_relay_rx,
3240 g_session.tcp_relay_frame_len,
3241 frame)) {
3242 const char *data = reinterpret_cast<const char *>(frame.data());
3243 ecl::Buffer buf;
3244 buf.assign(const_cast<char *>(data), frame.size());
3245 Uint8 player_id = 0;
3246 Uint8 expected = 0;
3247 Uint32 seed = 0;
3248 if (protocol::decode_welcome(buf, player_id, expected, seed)) {
3249 if (debug_enabled())
3250 debug_log("mp client: welcome (tcp relay) player=%u expected=%u seed=%u",
3251 static_cast<unsigned>(player_id),
3252 static_cast<unsigned>(expected),
3253 static_cast<unsigned>(seed));
3254 g_session.local_player = player_id;
3255 g_session.local_player_known = true;
3256 g_session.expected_players = expected;
3257 g_session.seed = seed;
3258 input::SetExpectedPlayers(expected);
3259 g_session.active_transport = TransportKind::TCP_RELAY;
3260 if (debug_enabled())
3261 debug_log("mp client: transport=%s", transport_name(g_session.active_transport));
3262 return true;
3263 }
3264 }
3265 }
3266 if (debug_enabled())
3267 debug_log("mp client: welcome timeout %s:%u (tcp relay)",
3268 relay_host.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
3269 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
3270 }
3271 } else if (debug_enabled()) {
3272 debug_log("mp client: connect failed %s:%u (tcp relay)",
3273 relay_host.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned>(relay_port));
3274 }
3275 }
3276 } else if (debug_enabled() && !enable_tcp_relay) {
3277 debug_log("mp client: tcp relay disabled");
3278 }
3279
3280 Shutdown();
3281 return false;
3282}
3283
3284void Tick(double dtime) {
3285 if (!g_session.active)
3286 return;
3287 g_session.input_clock_accu += dtime;
3288 if (g_session.input_clock_accu > 1.0)
3289 g_session.input_clock_accu = 1.0;
3290 while (g_session.input_clock_accu >= kInputTimestep) {
3291 g_session.input_clock_accu -= kInputTimestep;
3292 g_session.input_clock_tick += 1;
3293 }
3294 process_network_events();
3295 if (!g_session.active)
3296 return;
3297 if (g_session.has_pending_sync) {
3298 uint32_t local_tick = input::CurrentTick();
3299 if (local_tick == g_session.pending_sync.tick) {
3300 protocol::SyncPacket sync = g_session.pending_sync;
3301 g_session.has_pending_sync = false;
3302 handle_sync_current(sync);
3303 } else if (local_tick > g_session.pending_sync.tick) {
3304 protocol::SyncPacket sync = g_session.pending_sync;
3305 SessionState::ChecksumSample sample;
3306 if (lookup_checksum_sample(sync.tick, sample))
3307 handle_sync_sample(sync, sample);
3308 g_session.has_pending_sync = false;
3309 }
3310 }
3311 record_checksum_sample();
3312 if (g_session.resync_cooldown > 0.0) {
3313 g_session.resync_cooldown -= dtime;
3314 if (g_session.resync_cooldown < 0.0)
3315 g_session.resync_cooldown = 0.0;
3316 }
3317 if (!g_session.host && g_session.start_requested && !g_session.start_allowed) {
3318 g_session.ready_timer += dtime;
3319 if (g_session.ready_timer >= 0.5) {
3320 if (local_can_send_ready()) {
3321 send_ready_to_host();
3322 g_session.ready_sent = true;
3323 }
3324 g_session.ready_timer = 0.0;
3325 }
3326 }
3327 if (debug_enabled() && g_session.local_player_known && input::IsNetworked()) {
3328 static uint32_t last_missing_tick = UINT32_MAX;
3329 uint32_t tick = input::CurrentTick();
3330 if (tick != last_missing_tick) {
3331 bool missing = false;
3332 for (unsigned player = 0; player < g_session.expected_players; ++player) {
3333 if (!input::HasInput(tick, player)) {
3334 debug_log("mp missing input: tick=%u player=%u", tick, player);
3335 missing = true;
3336 }
3337 }
3338 if (missing)
3339 last_missing_tick = tick;
3340 }
3341 }
3342 if (g_session.start_requested) {
3343 if (g_session.host) {
3344 if (host_ready_to_start()) {
3345 if (debug_enabled())
3346 debug_log("mp host: start allowed");
3347 g_session.start_requested = false;
3348 g_session.start_allowed = true;
3349 g_session.input_epoch += 1;
3350 configure_input_session(g_session.expected_players);
3351 send_start_to_peers();
3352 server::Msg_StartGame();
3353 }
3354 } else if (g_session.start_allowed) {
3355 g_session.start_requested = false;
3356 server::Msg_StartGame();
3357 }
3358 }
3359 send_local_inputs();
3360 if (g_session.host) {
3361 g_session.sync_timer += dtime;
3362 if (g_session.sync_timer >= kSyncInterval) {
3363 g_session.sync_timer = 0.0;
3364 send_sync_to_peers();
3365 }
3366 }
3367}
3368
3369void Shutdown() {
3370 if (!g_session.active)
3371 return;
3372 if (g_session.relay_peer) {
3373 enet_peer_disconnect(g_session.relay_peer, 0);
3374 g_session.relay_peer = nullptr;
3375 }
3376 if (g_session.relay_handle) {
3377 enet_host_destroy(g_session.relay_handle);
3378 g_session.relay_handle = nullptr;
3379 }
3380 if (g_session.host_handle) {
3381 if (g_session.host) {
3382 for (const auto &entry : g_session.peer_players)
3383 enet_peer_disconnect(entry.first, 0);
3384 } else if (g_session.server_peer) {
3385 enet_peer_disconnect(g_session.server_peer, 0);
3386 }
3387 enet_host_destroy(g_session.host_handle);
3388 }
3389 tcp_close(g_session.tcp_relay_socket);
3390 g_session = SessionState();
3391 input::Reset();
3392}

275inline bool decode_resync_state(ecl::Buffer &buf, ResyncState &msg) {
276 Uint8 type = 0;
277 Uint32 epoch = 0;
278 Uint32 tick = 0;
279 Uint32 random_state = 0;
280 Uint16 count = 0;
281 if (!(buf >> type))
282 return false;
283 if (type != NET_RESYNC_STATE)
284 return false;
285 if (!(buf >> epoch >> tick >> random_state >> count))
286 return false;
287 msg.epoch = epoch;
288 msg.tick = tick;
289 msg.random_state = random_state;
290 msg.actors.clear();
291 msg.actors.reserve(count);
292 for (Uint16 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
293 ResyncActorState actor;
294 Uint32 object_id = 0;
295 Uint16 actor_id = 0;
296 Uint16 owner = 0;
297 float x = 0.0f;
298 float y = 0.0f;
299 float vx = 0.0f;
300 float vy = 0.0f;
301 if (!(buf >> object_id >> actor_id >> owner >> x >> y >> vx >> vy))
302 return false;

362 << Uint16(msg.x) << Uint16(msg.y);
363}

365inline bool decode_place(ecl::Buffer &buf, PlacementPacket &msg) {
366 Uint8 type = 0;
367 Uint32 restart_id = 0;
368 Uint8 player = 0;
369 Uint16 x = 0;
370 Uint16 y = 0;
371 if (!(buf >> type))
372 return false;
373 if (type != NET_PLACE)
374 return false;
375 if (!(buf >> restart_id >> player >> x >> y))
376 return false;
377 msg.restart_id = restart_id;
378 msg.player = player;
379 msg.x = x;
380 msg.y = y;
381 return true;

1#!/usr/bin/env bash
2set -euo pipefail
3
4LOBBY_HOST="${LOBBY_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
5LOBBY_PORT="${LOBBY_PORT:-12347}"
6RELAY_HOST="${RELAY_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
7RELAY_PORT="${RELAY_PORT:-12348}"
8TCP_RELAY_HOST="${TCP_RELAY_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
9TCP_RELAY_PORT="${TCP_RELAY_PORT:-12349}"
10
11echo "Starting lobby server on ${LOBBY_HOST}:${LOBBY_PORT}"
12python3 -u /opt/enigma/tools/internet_lobby_server.py --host "$LOBBY_HOST" --port "$LOBBY_PORT" &
13lobby_pid=$!
14
15echo "Starting relay server on ${RELAY_HOST}:${RELAY_PORT}"
16/usr/local/bin/enigma-relay "$RELAY_HOST" "$RELAY_PORT" &
17relay_pid=$!
18
19echo "Starting TCP relay server on ${TCP_RELAY_HOST}:${TCP_RELAY_PORT}"
20/usr/local/bin/enigma-tcp-relay "$TCP_RELAY_HOST" "$TCP_RELAY_PORT" &
21tcp_relay_pid=$!
22
23trap 'kill $lobby_pid $relay_pid $tcp_relay_pid' SIGINT SIGTERM
24
25wait -n "$lobby_pid" "$relay_pid" "$tcp_relay_pid"

1#!/usr/bin/env python3
2import argparse
3import random
4import socket
5import struct
6import time
7
8MAGIC = 0x52494E45 # "ENIR" little-endian
9VERSION = 1
10
11INET_CREATE = 1
12INET_JOIN = 2
13INET_LEAVE = 3
14INET_START = 4
15INET_POLL = 5
16INET_CREATE_OK = 101
17INET_JOIN_OK = 102
18INET_POLL_OK = 103
19INET_START_OK = 104
20INET_ERROR = 105
21
22
23def read_u8(data, offset):
24 if offset + 1 > len(data):
25 raise ValueError("short buffer")
26 return data[offset], offset + 1
27
28
29def read_u16(data, offset):
30 if offset + 2 > len(data):
31 raise ValueError("short buffer")
32 return struct.unpack_from("<H", data, offset)[0], offset + 2
33
34
35def read_u32(data, offset):
36 if offset + 4 > len(data):
37 raise ValueError("short buffer")
38 return struct.unpack_from("<I", data, offset)[0], offset + 4
39
40
41def read_str(data, offset):
42 length, offset = read_u16(data, offset)
43 if offset + length > len(data):
44 raise ValueError("short buffer")
45 value = data[offset:offset + length].decode("utf-8", "ignore")
46 return value, offset + length
47
48
49def write_u8(value):
50 return struct.pack("<B", value)
51
52
53def write_u16(value):
54 return struct.pack("<H", value)
55
56
57def write_u32(value):
58 return struct.pack("<I", value)
59
60
61def write_str(value):
62 raw = value.encode("utf-8")
63 return write_u16(len(raw)) + raw
64
65
66def make_code():
67 alphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
68 return "".join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(4))
69
70
71class Room:
72 def __init__(self, code, host_ip, host_port, start, host_id):
73 self.code = code
74 self.host_ip = host_ip
75 self.host_port = host_port
76 self.start = start
77 self.created_at = time.time()
78 self.last_seen = self.created_at
79 self.members = {host_id}
80 self.started = False
81
82 def expired(self, ttl):
83 return (time.time() - self.last_seen) > ttl
84
85
86def parse_start(payload):
87 # Layout A: session_id, seed, expected, host_port, filter, level_id, host_id
88 offset = 0
89 try:
90 session_id, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
91 seed, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
92 expected_players, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
93 host_port, offset = read_u16(payload, offset)
94 filter_optimized, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
95 level_id, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
96 host_id, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
97 return {
98 "session_id": session_id,
99 "seed": seed,
100 "expected_players": expected_players,
101 "host_port": host_port,
102 "filter_optimized": filter_optimized,
103 "level_id": level_id,
104 "host_id": host_id,
105 }
106 except Exception:
107 pass
108
109 # Layout B: optional lobby magic + session_id, level_id, seed, expected, host_port, host_id, filter
110 offset = 0
111 magic, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
112 if magic == 0x454E4C42: # "ENLB"
113 _version, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
114 _type, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
115 else:
116 offset = 0
117 magic = None
118
119 session_id, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
120 level_id, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
121 seed, offset = read_u32(payload, offset)
122 expected_players, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
123 host_port, offset = read_u16(payload, offset)
124 host_id, offset = read_str(payload, offset)
125 filter_optimized = 1
126 if offset < len(payload):
127 filter_optimized, offset = read_u8(payload, offset)
128 return {
129 "session_id": session_id,
130 "seed": seed,
131 "expected_players": expected_players,
132 "host_port": host_port,
133 "filter_optimized": filter_optimized,
134 "level_id": level_id,
135 "host_id": host_id,
136 }
137
138
139def build_start(start):
140 return (
141 write_u32(start["session_id"])
142 + write_str(start["level_id"])
143 + write_u32(start["seed"])
144 + write_u8(start["expected_players"])
145 + write_u16(start["host_port"])
146 + write_str(start["host_id"])
147 + write_u8(start["filter_optimized"])
148 )
149
150
151def handle_request(data, addr, rooms, ttl):
152 offset = 0
153 magic, offset = read_u32(data, offset)
154 version, offset = read_u8(data, offset)
155 msg_type, offset = read_u8(data, offset)
156 if magic != MAGIC or version != VERSION:
157 return None
158
159 if msg_type == INET_CREATE:
160 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
161 if not code:
162 return (
163 write_u32(MAGIC)
164 + write_u8(VERSION)
165 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
166 + write_str("please choose room code")
167 )
168 if code in rooms and not rooms[code].expired(ttl):
169 return (
170 write_u32(MAGIC)
171 + write_u8(VERSION)
172 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
173 + write_str("room code is already used")
174 )
175 start = parse_start(data[offset:])
176 rooms[code] = Room(code, addr[0], start["host_port"], start, start["host_id"])
177 resp = (
178 write_u32(MAGIC)
179 + write_u8(VERSION)
180 + write_u8(INET_CREATE_OK)
181 + write_str(code)
182 + write_str(addr[0])
183 )
184 return resp
185
186 if msg_type == INET_JOIN:
187 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
188 _client_id, offset = read_str(data, offset)
189 room = rooms.get(code)
190 if not room or room.expired(ttl):
191 rooms.pop(code, None)
192 return (
193 write_u32(MAGIC)
194 + write_u8(VERSION)
195 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
196 + write_str("Room not found.")
197 )
198 room.members.add(_client_id)
199 room.last_seen = time.time()
200 resp = (
201 write_u32(MAGIC)
202 + write_u8(VERSION)
203 + write_u8(INET_JOIN_OK)
204 + build_start(room.start)
205 + write_str(room.host_ip)
206 + write_u8(len(room.members))
207 )
208 return resp
209
210 if msg_type == INET_START:
211 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
212 room = rooms.get(code)
213 if not room or room.expired(ttl):
214 rooms.pop(code, None)
215 return (
216 write_u32(MAGIC)
217 + write_u8(VERSION)
218 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
219 + write_str("Room not found.")
220 )
221 start = parse_start(data[offset:])
222 room.start = start
223 room.host_ip = addr[0]
224 room.host_port = start["host_port"]
225 room.started = True
226 room.last_seen = time.time()
227 return (
228 write_u32(MAGIC)
229 + write_u8(VERSION)
230 + write_u8(INET_START_OK)
231 )
232
233 if msg_type == INET_POLL:
234 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
235 room = rooms.get(code)
236 if not room or room.expired(ttl):
237 rooms.pop(code, None)
238 return (
239 write_u32(MAGIC)
240 + write_u8(VERSION)
241 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
242 + write_str("Room not found.")
243 )
244 room.last_seen = time.time()
245 if not room.started:
246 return (
247 write_u32(MAGIC)
248 + write_u8(VERSION)
249 + write_u8(INET_POLL_OK)
250 + write_u8(0)
251 + write_u8(len(room.members))
252 )
253 return (
254 write_u32(MAGIC)
255 + write_u8(VERSION)
256 + write_u8(INET_POLL_OK)
257 + write_u8(1)
258 + write_u8(len(room.members))
259 + build_start(room.start)
260 + write_str(room.host_ip)
261 )
262
263 if msg_type == INET_LEAVE:
264 code, offset = read_str(data, offset)
265 client_id, offset = read_str(data, offset)
266 room = rooms.get(code)
267 if room:
268 room.members.discard(client_id)
269 room.last_seen = time.time()
270 if not room.members:
271 rooms.pop(code, None)
272 return (
273 write_u32(MAGIC)
274 + write_u8(VERSION)
275 + write_u8(INET_CREATE_OK)
276 + write_str(code)
277 + write_str("")
278 )
279
280 return None
281
282
283def main():
284 parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
285 parser.add_argument("--host", default="0.0.0.0")
286 parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=12347)
287 parser.add_argument("--ttl", type=int, default=1800, help="room TTL in seconds")
288 args = parser.parse_args()
289
290 sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
291 sock.bind((args.host, args.port))
292 sock.settimeout(1.0)
293
294 rooms = {}

296 while True:

299 except socket.timeout:
300 # cleanup

304 continue

309 write_u32(MAGIC)
310 + write_u8(VERSION)
311 + write_u8(INET_ERROR)
312 + write_str("Bad request.")
313 )
314 if response:
315 sock.sendto(response, addr)

18constexpr uint32_t kRelayMagic = 0x4C524E45; // "ENRL"
19constexpr uint8_t kRelayVersion = 1;
20constexpr size_t kRelayHeaderSize = 4 + 1 + 1 + 4 + 4;
21
22enum RelayType : uint8_t {
23 RELAY_HELLO_HOST = 1,
24 RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT = 2,
25 RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT = 3,
26 RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT = 4,
27 RELAY_SEND = 5,
28 RELAY_DATA = 6,
29 RELAY_ERROR = 7
30};

32struct RelayHeader {
33 uint8_t type = 0;
34 uint32_t session_id = 0;
35 uint32_t client_id = 0;
36};

50bool read_u8(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, size_t &offset, uint8_t &out) {
51 if (offset + 1 > size)
52 return false;
53 out = data[offset++];
54 return true;
55}
56
57bool read_u32(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, size_t &offset, uint32_t &out) {
58 if (offset + 4 > size)
59 return false;
60 out = static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset]) |
61 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 1]) << 8) |
62 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 2]) << 16) |
63 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 3]) << 24);
64 offset += 4;
65 return true;
66}
67
68void write_u32(std::vector<uint8_t> &out, uint32_t value) {
69 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(value & 0xFF));
70 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 8) & 0xFF));
71 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 16) & 0xFF));
72 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 24) & 0xFF));
73}
74
75bool parse_relay_header(const ENetPacket *packet, RelayHeader &out,
76 const uint8_t **payload, size_t *payload_len) {
77 const auto *data = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(packet->data);
78 size_t size = packet->dataLength;
79 size_t offset = 0;
80 uint32_t magic = 0;
81 uint8_t version = 0;
82 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, magic))
83 return false;
84 if (!read_u8(data, size, offset, version))
85 return false;
86 if (!read_u8(data, size, offset, out.type))
87 return false;
88 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, out.session_id))
89 return false;
90 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, out.client_id))
91 return false;
92 if (magic != kRelayMagic || version != kRelayVersion)
93 return false;
94 if (payload) {
95 *payload = data + offset;
96 }
97 if (payload_len) {
98 *payload_len = (offset <= size) ? (size - offset) : 0;
99 }
100 return true;
101}
102
103ENetPacket *make_relay_packet(uint8_t type, uint32_t session_id, uint32_t client_id,
104 const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len,
105 enet_uint32 flags) {
106 std::vector<uint8_t> data;
107 data.reserve(kRelayHeaderSize + payload_len);
108 write_u32(data, kRelayMagic);
109 data.push_back(kRelayVersion);
110 data.push_back(type);
111 write_u32(data, session_id);
112 write_u32(data, client_id);
113 if (payload && payload_len > 0) {
114 data.insert(data.end(), payload, payload + payload_len);
115 }
116 return enet_packet_create(data.data(), data.size(), flags);
117}

121int main(int argc, char **argv) {
122 if (enet_initialize() != 0) {
123 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize ENet\n");
124 return 1;
125 }
126 atexit(enet_deinitialize);
127 std::setvbuf(stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
128 std::setvbuf(stderr, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
129
130 const char *host_str = "0.0.0.0";
131 uint16_t port = 12348;
132 if (argc > 1)
133 host_str = argv[1];
134 if (argc > 2)
135 port = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::strtoul(argv[2], nullptr, 10));
136
137 ENetAddress address;
138 enet_address_set_host(&address, host_str);
139 address.port = port;
140 ENetHost *server = enet_host_create(&address, 64,
141#ifdef ENET_VER_EQ_GT_13
142 2 /* channels */,
143#endif
144 0, 0);
145 if (!server) {
146 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to create relay server on %s:%u\n", host_str, port);
147 return 1;
148 }
149
150 std::unordered_map<ENetPeer *, PeerInfo> peers;
151 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, RelaySession> sessions;
152
153 std::printf("Relay server listening on %s:%u\n", host_str, port);
154
155 while (true) {
156 ENetEvent event;
157 while (enet_host_service(server, &event, 1) > 0) {
158 switch (event.type) {
159 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_CONNECT: {
160 peers[event.peer] = PeerInfo();
161 break;
162 }
163 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_RECEIVE: {
164 auto info_it = peers.find(event.peer);
165 if (info_it == peers.end()) {
166 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
167 break;
168 }
169 PeerInfo &info = info_it->second;
170 if (info.role == PeerInfo::UNKNOWN) {
171 RelayHeader header;
172 if (!parse_relay_header(event.packet, header, nullptr, nullptr)) {
173 enet_peer_disconnect(event.peer, 0);
174 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
175 break;
176 }
177 if (header.type == RELAY_HELLO_HOST) {
178 info.role = PeerInfo::HOST;
179 info.session_id = header.session_id;
180 auto &session = sessions[header.session_id];
181 if (session.host && session.host != event.peer)
182 enet_peer_disconnect(session.host, 0);
183 session.host = event.peer;
184 for (const auto &entry : session.clients) {
185 ENetPacket *packet = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT,
186 header.session_id,
187 entry.first, nullptr, 0,
188 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
189 enet_peer_send(session.host, 0, packet);
190 }
191 } else if (header.type == RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT) {
192 info.role = PeerInfo::CLIENT;
193 info.session_id = header.session_id;
194 auto &session = sessions[header.session_id];
195 uint32_t client_id = session.next_client_id++;
196 info.client_id = client_id;
197 session.clients[client_id] = event.peer;
198 if (session.host) {
199 ENetPacket *packet = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT,
200 header.session_id,
201 client_id, nullptr, 0,
202 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
203 enet_peer_send(session.host, 0, packet);
204 }
205 } else {
206 enet_peer_disconnect(event.peer, 0);
207 }
208 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
209 break;
210 }
211 if (info.role == PeerInfo::CLIENT) {
212 auto session_it = sessions.find(info.session_id);
213 if (session_it != sessions.end() && session_it->second.host) {
214 ENetPacket *packet = make_relay_packet(RELAY_DATA,
215 info.session_id,
216 info.client_id,
217 static_cast<const uint8_t *>(event.packet->data),
218 event.packet->dataLength,
219 event.packet->flags);
220 enet_peer_send(session_it->second.host, 0, packet);
221 }
222 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
223 break;
224 }
225 if (info.role == PeerInfo::HOST) {
226 RelayHeader header;
227 const uint8_t *payload = nullptr;
228 size_t payload_len = 0;
229 if (!parse_relay_header(event.packet, header, &payload, &payload_len)) {
230 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
231 break;
232 }
233 if (header.type == RELAY_SEND) {
234 auto session_it = sessions.find(info.session_id);
235 if (session_it != sessions.end()) {
236 auto client_it = session_it->second.clients.find(header.client_id);
237 if (client_it != session_it->second.clients.end()) {
238 ENetPacket *packet = enet_packet_create(payload, payload_len,
239 event.packet->flags);
240 enet_peer_send(client_it->second, 0, packet);
241 }
242 }
243 }
244 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
245 break;
246 }
247 enet_packet_destroy(event.packet);
248 break;
249 }
250 case ENET_EVENT_TYPE_DISCONNECT: {
251 auto info_it = peers.find(event.peer);
252 if (info_it == peers.end())
253 break;
254 PeerInfo info = info_it->second;
255 peers.erase(info_it);
256 if (info.role == PeerInfo::HOST) {
257 auto session_it = sessions.find(info.session_id);
258 if (session_it != sessions.end() && session_it->second.host == event.peer) {
259 for (const auto &entry : session_it->second.clients)
260 enet_peer_disconnect(entry.second, 0);
261 sessions.erase(session_it);
262 }
263 } else if (info.role == PeerInfo::CLIENT) {
264 auto session_it = sessions.find(info.session_id);
265 if (session_it != sessions.end()) {
266 session_it->second.clients.erase(info.client_id);
267 if (session_it->second.host) {
268 ENetPacket *packet = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT,
269 info.session_id,
270 info.client_id, nullptr, 0,
271 ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE);
272 enet_peer_send(session_it->second.host, 0, packet);
273 }
274 if (!session_it->second.host && session_it->second.clients.empty())
275 sessions.erase(session_it);
276 }
277 }
278 break;
279 }
280 default:
281 break;
282 }
283 }
284 }
285
286 enet_host_destroy(server);
287 return 0;
288}

53void set_nonblocking(int fd) {
54 int flags = fcntl(fd, F_GETFL, 0);
55 if (flags >= 0)
56 fcntl(fd, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);
57}
58
59bool send_all(int fd, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
60 size_t sent = 0;
61 while (sent < len) {
62 ssize_t n = ::send(fd, data + sent, len - sent, 0);
63 if (n > 0) {
64 sent += static_cast<size_t>(n);
65 continue;
66 }
67 if (n < 0 && (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)) {
68 pollfd pfd;
69 pfd.fd = fd;
70 pfd.events = POLLOUT;
71 pfd.revents = 0;
72 int rc = ::poll(&pfd, 1, 250);
73 if (rc <= 0)
74 return false;
75 continue;
76 }
77 return false;
78 }
79 return true;
80}
81
82bool send_frame(int fd, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
83 if (len == 0 || len > kMaxFrame)
84 return false;
85 uint8_t prefix[4];
86 uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(len);
87 prefix[0] = static_cast<uint8_t>(v & 0xFF);
88 prefix[1] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
89 prefix[2] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
90 prefix[3] = static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> 24) & 0xFF);
91 return send_all(fd, prefix, sizeof(prefix)) && send_all(fd, data, len);
92}

97 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 16) & 0xFF));
98 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 24) & 0xFF));
99}

104 out = data[offset++];

112 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 1]) << 8) |
113 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 2]) << 16) |
114 (static_cast<uint32_t>(data[offset + 3]) << 24);
115 offset += 4;
116 return true;
117}

119bool parse_relay_header(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, RelayHeader &out,
120 const uint8_t **payload, size_t *payload_len) {
121 size_t offset = 0;
122 uint32_t magic = 0;
123 uint8_t version = 0;
124 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, magic))
125 return false;
126 if (!read_u8(data, size, offset, version))
127 return false;
128 if (!read_u8(data, size, offset, out.type))
129 return false;
130 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, out.session_id))
131 return false;
132 if (!read_u32(data, size, offset, out.client_id))
133 return false;
134 if (magic != kRelayMagic || version != kRelayVersion)
135 return false;
136 if (payload)
137 *payload = data + offset;
138 if (payload_len)
139 *payload_len = (offset <= size) ? (size - offset) : 0;
140 return true;
141}

143std::vector<uint8_t> make_relay_packet(uint8_t type, uint32_t session_id, uint32_t client_id,
144 const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len) {
145 std::vector<uint8_t> out;
146 out.reserve(4 + 1 + 1 + 4 + 4 + payload_len);
147 write_u32(out, kRelayMagic);
148 out.push_back(kRelayVersion);
149 out.push_back(type);
150 write_u32(out, session_id);
151 write_u32(out, client_id);
152 if (payload && payload_len)
153 out.insert(out.end(), payload, payload + payload_len);
154 return out;
155}

157bool pump_recv(Conn &c) {
158 uint8_t buf[4096];
159 while (true) {
160 ssize_t n = ::recv(c.fd, buf, sizeof(buf), 0);
161 if (n == 0)
162 return false;
163 if (n < 0) {
164 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)
165 break;
166 return false;
167 }
168 c.rx.insert(c.rx.end(), buf, buf + n);
169 if (static_cast<size_t>(n) < sizeof(buf))
170 break;
171 }
172 return true;
173}
174
175bool try_extract_frame(Conn &c, std::vector<uint8_t> &out) {
176 out.clear();
177 if (c.pending_len == 0) {
178 if (c.rx.size() < 4)
179 return false;
180 uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(c.rx[0]) |
181 (static_cast<uint32_t>(c.rx[1]) << 8) |
182 (static_cast<uint32_t>(c.rx[2]) << 16) |
183 (static_cast<uint32_t>(c.rx[3]) << 24);
184 c.rx.erase(c.rx.begin(), c.rx.begin() + 4);
185 if (v == 0 || v > kMaxFrame) {
186 c.rx.clear();
187 c.pending_len = 0;
188 return false;
189 }
190 c.pending_len = v;
191 }
192 if (c.rx.size() < c.pending_len)
193 return false;
194 out.assign(c.rx.begin(), c.rx.begin() + c.pending_len);
195 c.rx.erase(c.rx.begin(), c.rx.begin() + c.pending_len);
196 c.pending_len = 0;
197 return true;
198}
