202int main(int argc, char **argv) {
203 std::setvbuf(stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
204 std::setvbuf(stderr, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
205
206 const char *host = "0.0.0.0";
207 uint16_t port = 12349;
208 if (argc > 1)
209 host = argv[1];
210 if (argc > 2)
211 port = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::strtoul(argv[2], nullptr, 10));
212
213 addrinfo hints;
214 std::memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
215 hints.ai_family = AF_INET;
216 hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
217 hints.ai_flags = AI_PASSIVE;
218
219 addrinfo *res = nullptr;
220 std::string port_str = std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned>(port));
221 if (getaddrinfo(host, port_str.c_str(), &hints, &res) != 0) {
222 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to resolve bind address\n");
223 return 1;
224 }
225
226 int listen_fd = ::socket(res->ai_family, res->ai_socktype, res->ai_protocol);
227 if (listen_fd < 0) {
228 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to create socket\n");
229 freeaddrinfo(res);
230 return 1;
231 }
232
233 int opt = 1;
234 setsockopt(listen_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
235
236 if (::bind(listen_fd, res->ai_addr, static_cast<socklen_t>(res->ai_addrlen)) != 0) {
237 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to bind %s:%u\n", host, port);
238 freeaddrinfo(res);
239 close(listen_fd);
240 return 1;
241 }
242 freeaddrinfo(res);
243
244 if (::listen(listen_fd, 64) != 0) {
245 std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to listen\n");
246 close(listen_fd);
247 return 1;
248 }
249
250 set_nonblocking(listen_fd);
251
252 std::printf("TCP relay server listening on %s:%u\n", host, port);
253
254 std::unordered_map<int, Conn> conns;
255 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, Session> sessions;
256
257 while (true) {
258 std::vector<pollfd> fds;
259 fds.reserve(conns.size() + 1);
260 fds.push_back({listen_fd, POLLIN, 0});
261 for (const auto &kv : conns)
262 fds.push_back({kv.first, POLLIN, 0});
263
264 int rc = ::poll(fds.data(), fds.size(), 10);
265 if (rc < 0)
266 continue;
267
268 if (fds[0].revents & POLLIN) {
269 while (true) {
270 sockaddr_in addr;
271 socklen_t alen = sizeof(addr);
272 int fd = ::accept(listen_fd, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr *>(&addr), &alen);
273 if (fd < 0) {
274 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)
275 break;
276 break;
277 }
278 set_nonblocking(fd);
279 conns[fd] = Conn{fd};
280 }
281 }
282
283 std::vector<int> to_close;
284 std::vector<uint8_t> frame;
285
286 for (size_t i = 1; i < fds.size(); ++i) {
287 int fd = fds[i].fd;
288 if ((fds[i].revents & (POLLIN | POLLERR | POLLHUP)) == 0)
289 continue;
290 auto it = conns.find(fd);
291 if (it == conns.end())
292 continue;
293 Conn &c = it->second;
294
295 if (!pump_recv(c)) {
296 to_close.push_back(fd);
297 continue;
298 }
299
300 while (try_extract_frame(c, frame)) {
301 if (c.role == Conn::UNKNOWN) {
302 RelayHeader hdr;
303 const uint8_t *payload = nullptr;
304 size_t payload_len = 0;
305 if (!parse_relay_header(frame.data(), frame.size(), hdr, &payload, &payload_len)) {
306 to_close.push_back(fd);
307 break;
308 }
309 if (hdr.type == RELAY_HELLO_HOST) {
310 c.role = Conn::HOST;
311 c.session_id = hdr.session_id;
312 Session &s = sessions[c.session_id];
313 s.host_fd = fd;
314 // Notify host about already connected clients.
315 for (const auto &entry : s.clients) {
316 auto pkt = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT, c.session_id,
317 entry.first, nullptr, 0);
318 send_frame(fd, pkt.data(), pkt.size());
319 }
320 } else if (hdr.type == RELAY_HELLO_CLIENT) {
321 c.role = Conn::CLIENT;
322 c.session_id = hdr.session_id;
323 Session &s = sessions[c.session_id];
324 c.client_id = s.next_client_id++;
325 s.clients[c.client_id] = fd;
326 if (s.host_fd >= 0) {
327 auto pkt = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_CONNECT, c.session_id,
328 c.client_id, nullptr, 0);
329 send_frame(s.host_fd, pkt.data(), pkt.size());
330 }
331 } else {
332 to_close.push_back(fd);
333 break;
334 }
335 continue;
336 }
337
338 if (c.role == Conn::CLIENT) {
339 auto sit = sessions.find(c.session_id);
340 if (sit != sessions.end() && sit->second.host_fd >= 0) {
341 auto pkt = make_relay_packet(RELAY_DATA, c.session_id, c.client_id,
342 frame.data(), frame.size());
343 send_frame(sit->second.host_fd, pkt.data(), pkt.size());
344 }
345 continue;
346 }
347
348 if (c.role == Conn::HOST) {
349 RelayHeader hdr;
350 const uint8_t *payload = nullptr;
351 size_t payload_len = 0;
352 if (!parse_relay_header(frame.data(), frame.size(), hdr, &payload, &payload_len))
353 continue;
354 if (hdr.type != RELAY_SEND)
355 continue;
356 auto sit = sessions.find(c.session_id);
357 if (sit == sessions.end())
358 continue;
359 auto cit = sit->second.clients.find(hdr.client_id);
360 if (cit == sit->second.clients.end())
361 continue;
362 send_frame(cit->second, payload, payload_len);
363 continue;
364 }
365 }
366 }
367
368 // Apply queued disconnects (and send control notifications).
369 for (int fd : to_close) {
370 auto it = conns.find(fd);
371 if (it == conns.end())
372 continue;
373 Conn c = it->second;
374 conns.erase(it);
375 close(fd);
376
377 if (c.role == Conn::CLIENT) {
378 auto sit = sessions.find(c.session_id);
379 if (sit != sessions.end()) {
380 sit->second.clients.erase(c.client_id);
381 if (sit->second.host_fd >= 0) {
382 auto pkt = make_relay_packet(RELAY_CLIENT_DISCONNECT, c.session_id,
383 c.client_id, nullptr, 0);
384 send_frame(sit->second.host_fd, pkt.data(), pkt.size());
385 }
386 if (sit->second.host_fd < 0 && sit->second.clients.empty())
387 sessions.erase(sit);
388 }
389 } else if (c.role == Conn::HOST) {
390 auto sit = sessions.find(c.session_id);
391 if (sit != sessions.end() && sit->second.host_fd == fd) {
392 // Close all clients when the host goes away.
393 for (const auto &entry : sit->second.clients) {
394 int cfd = entry.second;
395 auto cit = conns.find(cfd);
396 if (cit != conns.end()) {
397 conns.erase(cit);
398 close(cfd);
399 }
400 }
401 sessions.erase(sit);
402 }
403 }
404 }
405 }
406}
